zh.tag: 时空组合性的元框架，重新定义空间计算编程范式
zh.what: Cordis 是一个元框架，旨在实现时空组合性（Spatiotemporal Composability），即在不同时间和空间尺度上组合计算单元。它提供了一种新的编程范式，使开发者能够以声明式方式构建具有空间和时间感知能力的应用。目前处于积极开发阶段，API 尚不稳定。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架源码、文档（cordis-primer）以及相关论文（A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability）。主要提供类型定义、运行时和组合原语。
zh.stack: 使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖现代 JS 生态，可能涉及 WebAssembly 或 WebGPU 用于高性能计算。
zh.hot: 今日新增 599 star，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜，因其创新的时空组合性概念吸引了大量关注，可能填补空间计算编程范式的空白。
uses: 空间计算应用开发者，如 AR/VR、地理信息系统、数字孪生
研究新型编程范式的学者和工程师
需要处理时空数据（如物联网、自动驾驶）的开发者

en.tag: Meta-framework for spatiotemporal composability, redefining spatial computing paradigm
en.what: Cordis is a meta-framework designed to achieve spatiotemporal composability, enabling composition of computational units across different spatial and temporal scales. It offers a new programming paradigm for building applications with spatial and temporal awareness declaratively. Currently under active development with unstable API.
en.content: The repository contains core framework source code, documentation (cordis-primer), and a related paper. It provides type definitions, runtime, and composition primitives.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, leveraging modern JS ecosystem, possibly involving WebAssembly or WebGPU for high-performance computing.
en.hot: Gained 599 stars today, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending daily, attracting attention for its innovative spatiotemporal composability concept, potentially filling a gap in spatial computing programming paradigms.
uses: Developers building spatial computing apps like AR/VR, GIS, digital twins
Researchers and engineers exploring new programming paradigms
Developers dealing with spatiotemporal data (IoT, autonomous driving)

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 打造 29 种编辑级图表，纯 HTML+SVG
zh.what: 这是一个 Claude Code 技能（skill），能生成 29 种编辑级质量的图表，如架构图、流程图、时序图等。所有图表均为自包含的 HTML+SVG，无外部依赖，可直接在浏览器打开。它还能将 draw.io 或 Mermaid 源文件重绘为指定格式、尺寸和细节级别。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能文件、文档和截图，展示了 27 种视觉类型（README 提到 29 种，可能版本更新）的三种静态变体：极简浅色、极简深色和完整编辑风格。每种类型都有对应的 HTML 模板，无需构建步骤。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML 和 SVG，无 JavaScript、无外部图片依赖。作为 Claude Code 技能，也兼容 Codex 和 Pi。
zh.hot: 今日新增 2855 星，总星数破万，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。它解决了 AI 生成图表千篇一律的痛点，提供编辑级设计，让图表不再像“Mermaid 垃圾”。
uses: 内容创作者和博主：快速生成与网站风格一致的图表，提升文章专业度。
开发者：在文档或代码注释中嵌入高质量图表，无需手动设计。
产品经理和架构师：用语义化模式描述系统行为，自动生成清晰图表。
设计师：作为快速原型工具，避免繁琐的 Figma 操作。

en.tag: 29 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, self-contained HTML+SVG
en.what: A Claude Code skill that generates 29 editorial-quality diagram types, including architecture, flowchart, sequence, and more. All diagrams are self-contained HTML+SVG with no external dependencies, openable directly in a browser. It can also redraw draw.io or Mermaid sources at a chosen format, size, and detail level.
en.content: The repo contains the skill files, docs, and screenshots showcasing 27 visual types (README mentions 29, possibly updated) in three static variants: minimal light, minimal dark, and full-editorial. Each type has an HTML template, no build step required.
en.stack: Primarily HTML and SVG, no JavaScript, no external image dependencies. As a Claude Code skill, it's also compatible with Codex and Pi.
en.hot: Gained 2,855 stars today, surpassing 10k total, and topped the GitHub Trending daily list. It solves the pain point of generic AI-generated diagrams, offering editorial design that avoids 'Mermaid-slop'.
uses: Content creators and bloggers: quickly generate diagrams matching their website style to enhance professionalism.
Developers: embed high-quality diagrams in docs or code comments without manual design.
Product managers and architects: use semantic patterns to describe system behavior and auto-generate clear diagrams.
Designers: as a rapid prototyping tool to avoid tedious Figma operations.

zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Cursor SDK（@cursor/sdk），插件通过 plugin.json 清单定义，可能涉及 MCP、CLI 工具等。
zh.hot: Cursor 作为 AI 编辑器热度极高，官方插件仓库是生态扩展的关键入口，今日新增 27 星，总星数 2645，登上 TypeScript 日榜第 7 名，开发者关注如何用插件增强 AI 代理工作流。
uses: Cursor 用户：安装官方插件提升代码审查、文档浏览等效率
插件开发者：参考规范与示例创建自己的 Cursor 插件

en.what: This is the official Cursor plugin repository, containing the plugin specification (manifest format) and a collection of first-party and third-party plugins for code review, docs visualization, CLI design, Gmail/Drive integration, and more. Each plugin lives in its own directory with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest.
en.content: Each plugin is a standalone folder at the repo root, e.g., continual-learning, cursor-team-kit, pr-review-canvas, orchestrate, plus a third_party directory for Gmail, Google Drive, etc.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on the Cursor SDK (@cursor/sdk), plugins defined via plugin.json manifests, may involve MCP, CLI tools, etc.

Plugin developers: reference the spec and examples to create your own plugins
Teams: leverage Team Kit, Orchestrate, etc. to streamline CI/CD and parallel task handling

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: 本地运行与训练大模型和扩散模型的桌面应用
zh.what: Unsloth 是一个本地优先的 AI 工具，允许用户在个人电脑上运行和训练大型语言模型（LLM）和扩散模型。它支持包括 Qwen3.8、Kimi K3、MiniMax-H3、Gemma 4、DeepSeek-V4 和 FLUX 在内的多种模型，并提供桌面应用和命令行安装方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用安装包（Windows、macOS、Linux）、命令行安装脚本、文档和示例笔记本。核心功能是模型运行、训练和部署，并支持与 Claude Code、Codex 和 MCP 等代理工具集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，支持多种模型架构。桌面应用可能使用 Electron 或类似技术打包。
zh.hot: Unsloth 因提供本地运行和训练 AI 模型的便捷方式而广受欢迎，star 数已达 7 万，日增 592，反映了用户对隐私和本地控制的需求。
uses: AI 开发者和研究者：在本地快速实验和微调模型，无需云服务。
隐私敏感用户：希望数据不出本地，避免云端泄露风险。
教育者与学生：学习模型训练和推理，无需昂贵硬件。
代理工具用户：将本地模型与 Claude Code、Codex 等集成，构建自动化工作流。

en.tag: Local desktop app to run and train LLMs and diffusion models
en.what: Unsloth is a local-first AI tool that lets users run and train large language models (LLMs) and diffusion models on their own hardware. It supports a wide range of models including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, and FLUX, and offers a desktop app as well as command-line installation.
en.content: The repository contains desktop app installers for Windows, macOS, and Linux, command-line install scripts, documentation, and example notebooks. Core features include model running, training, and deployment, with integrations for agent tools like Claude Code, Codex, and MCP.
en.stack: Built with Python, relying on deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, supporting multiple model architectures. The desktop app is likely packaged with Electron or similar technology.
en.hot: Unsloth is popular for providing a convenient way to run and train AI models locally, with 70k stars and 592 new stars today, reflecting the demand for privacy and local control.
uses: AI developers and researchers: quickly experiment and fine-tune models locally without cloud services.
Privacy-conscious users: keep data on-device to avoid cloud leaks.
Educators and students: learn model training and inference without expensive hardware.
Agent tool users: integrate local models with Claude Code, Codex, etc., for automated workflows.

zh.tag: 一条命令微调大模型，4GB 显卡也能跑 8B
zh.what: Soup 是一个命令行工具，让你通过一个 YAML 配置文件就能微调或后训练大语言模型，无需 SSH 或复杂配置。它采用层流式训练技术，将冻结的基座模型逐层送入 GPU，从而在 4GB 显存的笔记本上也能训练 8B 模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包 soup-cli，提供 init、train 等命令，以及配置模板、文档和示例。核心是层流式训练引擎，支持多种模型和数据集。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10-3.12，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习库，支持 NF4 量化，与 Hugging Face 生态兼容。
zh.hot: 今日新增 297 星，总星数 1659，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 7。它解决了 LLM 微调的高门槛问题，让普通开发者也能在消费级硬件上微调大模型，因此迅速走红。
uses: 独立开发者或研究者，想在本地微调 8B 模型而无需昂贵 GPU
需要快速实验不同配置的 AI 工程师，通过 YAML 简化流程
教育场景，用于教学或学习 LLM 微调原理

en.tag: Fine-tune LLMs with one command, even 8B on a 4GB GPU
en.what: Soup is a CLI tool that lets you fine-tune or post-train LLMs with a single YAML config and one command, no SSH or config hell. It uses layer streaming to feed the frozen base model layer-by-layer to the GPU, enabling fine-tuning of 8B models on a 4GB laptop GPU.
en.content: The repo contains the Python package soup-cli with commands like init and train, along with config templates, docs, and examples. The core is a layer-streaming training engine supporting various models and datasets.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10-3.12, relies on PyTorch and deep learning libraries, supports NF4 quantization, and is compatible with the Hugging Face ecosystem.
en.hot: Gained 297 stars today, total 1659, ranking #7 on GitHub Trending. It lowers the barrier to LLM fine-tuning, enabling developers to fine-tune large models on consumer hardware, hence its rapid popularity.
uses: Independent developers or researchers who want to fine-tune 8B models locally without expensive GPUs
AI engineers needing to quickly experiment with different configs via YAML
Educational contexts for teaching or learning LLM fine-tuning

zh.tag: 让 AI 编码代理遵循规范开发流程的开源工具包
zh.what: Spec Kit 是一个开源工具包，旨在帮助开发团队在编写代码之前先定义规范，然后让 AI 编码代理根据这些规范直接生成实现。它提供了一套即用型的规范驱动流程，也可自定义扩展，支持整个组织协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Specify CLI 命令行工具、文档、示例规范、扩展与预设（presets）、基于角色的捆绑包（bundles），以及社区贡献的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖 uv 进行包管理，可通过 PyPI 或 Git 安装。
zh.hot: 凭借 12.8 万星标和日增 1160 星的热度，它抓住了 AI 编码代理时代对结构化开发流程的需求，由 GitHub 官方出品，可信度高。
uses: 开发团队：希望用 AI 代理提高编码效率，同时保持代码质量与一致性
技术负责人：需要为团队制定标准化开发流程，并确保 AI 工具遵循规范
AI 工具开发者：希望集成或扩展规范驱动开发流程的开发者

en.tag: Open-source toolkit for spec-driven development with any AI coding agent
en.what: Spec Kit is an open-source toolkit that helps teams define specifications before writing code, then lets AI coding agents generate implementations directly from those specs. It provides a ready-to-use spec-driven process, is extensible, and supports organization-wide collaboration.
en.content: The repository includes the Specify CLI tool, documentation, example specs, extensions and presets, role-based bundles, and community-contributed integrations.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, uses uv for package management, installable via PyPI or Git.
en.hot: With 128k stars and +1,160 stars today, it taps into the need for structured development processes in the AI coding agent era, backed by GitHub official, boosting credibility.
uses: Development teams: want to use AI agents for coding efficiency while maintaining quality and consistency
Tech leads: need to establish standardized development processes and ensure AI tools follow specs
AI tool developers: those looking to integrate or extend spec-driven development workflows

zh.tag: 邮箱账号关联查询 OSINT 工具
zh.what: holehe 是一个 OSINT 工具，用于检查邮箱是否在 Twitter、Instagram 等 120 多个网站上注册过账号。它利用“忘记密码”功能来获取相关信息，且不会向目标邮箱发送任何通知。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包和命令行工具，支持通过 PyPI、GitHub 或 Docker 安装。提供 CLI 和 Python API，模块化设计，每个模块返回标准化的 JSON 格式数据。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3，使用 trio 和 httpx 进行异步 HTTP 请求，依赖少量第三方库。
zh.hot: star 数达 12k+，今日新增 195，因其在 OSINT 和隐私研究领域的高效性和隐蔽性而广受欢迎。
uses: 安全研究人员进行账号枚举和足迹分析
隐私保护者检查自己的邮箱暴露范围
调查记者或社工场景下的信息收集
开发者集成到自定义 OSINT 工具链

en.tag: OSINT tool to check email registrations across sites
en.what: holehe is an OSINT tool that checks if an email is registered on over 120 websites like Twitter and Instagram. It retrieves information via the forgotten password function without alerting the target email.
en.content: The repo contains a Python package and CLI tool, installable via PyPI, GitHub, or Docker. It offers both CLI and Python API, with modular design returning standardized JSON data.
en.stack: Built on Python 3, uses trio and httpx for async HTTP requests, with minimal third-party dependencies.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and 195 new today, it's popular for its efficiency and stealth in OSINT and privacy research.
uses: Security researchers for account enumeration and footprinting
Privacy-conscious individuals checking their email exposure
Investigative journalists or social engineering info gathering
Developers integrating into custom OSINT pipelines

zh.tag: macOS 本地语音听写应用，AI 增强，Wispr Flow 替代品
zh.what: FluidVoice 是一款开源的 macOS 语音转文字听写应用，支持本地语音识别和 AI 增强。它提供极速的听写体验，并强调隐私保护，所有处理均在设备上完成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 macOS 应用源码，支持多种语音模型（如 Parakeet、Whisper 等），并集成了 Fluid Intelligence 本地 AI 增强引擎。提供 Homebrew 安装和手动下载。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Swift 开发，依赖 macOS 原生框架和语音识别模型，支持本地 AI 推理。
zh.hot: 凭借极速本地听写和 AI 增强功能，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 104 星，总星数破万。
uses: macOS 用户需要快速、隐私的语音听写工具
开发者希望集成或学习本地语音识别与 AI 增强技术
Wispr Flow 用户寻找免费开源替代品

en.tag: Fastest on-device dictation app for macOS with AI enhancement, a local Wispr Flow alternative
en.what: FluidVoice is an open-source voice-to-text dictation app for macOS with on-device AI enhancement. It offers blazing-fast dictation with privacy, as all processing happens locally.
en.content: The repository contains the full macOS app source code, supporting multiple speech models (e.g., Parakeet, Whisper), and integrates the Fluid Intelligence local AI enhancement engine. Installation via Homebrew or manual download.

en.hot: Gaining popularity for its fast local dictation and AI enhancement, it added 104 stars today, surpassing 10k total stars.
uses: macOS users needing fast, private dictation
Developers looking to integrate or learn on-device speech recognition and AI enhancement
Wispr Flow users seeking a free open-source alternative

zh.tag: 开源低代码平台，构建内部工具与AI代理

需要快速搭建业务应用的非技术用户

Enterprises seeking self-hosted low-code solutions

zh.what: CLI-Anything 是一个框架，能够为任意软件自动生成命令行接口（CLI），使 AI 代理能够直接操作这些软件。它提供了一个 CLI-Hub，用于浏览、安装和管理社区构建的 CLI，并支持预览和轨迹循环，让代理能生成真实产物（如 CAD 模型、3D 场景等）。

en.tag: Make all software agent-native with auto-generated CLIs and a hub
en.what: CLI-Anything is a framework that automatically generates command-line interfaces (CLIs) for any software, enabling AI agents to operate them directly. It provides a CLI-Hub for browsing, installing, and managing community-built CLIs, with preview and trajectory loops that let agents produce real artifacts like CAD models and 3D scenes.
en.content: The repo includes the core framework, CLI-Hub installer, 18 demo apps, 2,461 passing tests, a tech report, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Built with Python (≥3.10), uses Click for CLI construction, pytest for testing, and outputs JSON for agent consumption.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents, the need for agents to operate all software has surged; this project offers a universal solution, reaching 47k stars with 118 new today, trending on GitHub.
uses: AI agent developers: quickly generate CLIs for existing software to enable agent invocation
Software users: install community CLIs via CLI-Hub and control software with natural language
Developers wanting to contribute CLIs to the agent ecosystem: contribute or submit wishlist requests

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的开源图原生上下文与决策基础设施

Regulated industries (finance, healthcare): requiring traceable decisions and compliance.
Knowledge graph developers: leveraging graph-native infrastructure for knowledge modeling and causal reasoning.
AI researchers: exploring implementations of context-aware and accountable AI systems.

渗透测试人员：在授权评估中快速侦察目标信息。

Penetration testers: for rapid reconnaissance during authorized assessments.

Researchers: to explore OSINT data sources and analysis methods.

en.stack: Pure JavaScript implementation with no runtime dependencies. Built with lodash-cli, supports UMD module format, and works in modern environments.
en.hot: As a cornerstone of the JavaScript ecosystem, Lodash holds 61k+ stars with a monthly gain of 106, consistently trending. Recent support from the OpenJS Foundation and governance reboot to ensure long-term stability have drawn community attention.
uses: Frontend developers: quickly handle common operations on arrays, objects, strings, etc., reducing boilerplate.
Node.js backend developers: use modular methods to boost development efficiency on the server.
Learners of functional programming in JS: experience auto-currying and data-last style via the FP build.
Maintainers of legacy projects: rely on it as a stable dependency with compatibility patches and performance optimizations.

zh.tag: 低多边形 3D 模型编辑器，支持 Minecraft 格式与插件
zh.what: Blockbench 是一款免费开源的 3D 模型编辑器，专注于低多边形模型和像素艺术纹理。它支持导出多种标准格式，可用于游戏引擎、3D 打印等，并针对 Minecraft Java 和基岩版提供专用格式和功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的编辑器源码，支持通过 Electron 运行桌面应用或通过浏览器运行 Web 应用，并提供插件 API 和主题定制功能。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript，使用 Node.js 和 Electron 构建，支持 npm 管理依赖，插件使用 JavaScript 编写。
zh.hot: 凭借对 Minecraft 社区的强大支持、友好的界面和丰富的插件生态，持续吸引大量用户，今日新增 10 星，位居 JavaScript 趋势榜第 8。
uses: Minecraft 模组制作者：创建自定义方块、物品和实体模型
游戏开发者：制作低多边形资产并导出到游戏引擎
3D 打印爱好者：设计并导出可打印的模型
教育场景：学习 3D 建模和像素艺术

en.tag: Low-poly 3D model editor with Minecraft support and plugins
en.what: Blockbench is a free and open-source 3D model editor for low-poly models with pixel art textures. It exports to standard formats for game engines, 3D printing, and more, with dedicated support for Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, runnable as a desktop app via Electron or as a web app, with plugin API and theme customization.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, Node.js, and Electron, with npm for dependencies and JavaScript-based plugins.
en.hot: With strong Minecraft community support, a beginner-friendly interface, and a rich plugin ecosystem, it keeps gaining stars (10 today), ranking #8 on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: Minecraft modders: create custom block, item, and entity models
Game developers: make low-poly assets and export to game engines
3D printing enthusiasts: design and export printable models
Educational use: learn 3D modeling and pixel art

zh.tag: 模块化 SenseNova 技能，构建 AI 办公助手与生产力工作流
zh.what: 该仓库提供一系列模块化的 SenseNova 技能，用于构建 AI 驱动的办公助手和生产力工作流。每个技能独立成目录，通过 SKILL.md 声明触发条件、能力和执行流程，遵循 Agent Skills 规范，可单独使用或组合成端到端工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含图像生成与可视化、幻灯片（PPT）生成、Excel 数据分析、深度研究等技能，并附带近 100 个信息图生成案例的文档。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 JavaScript，技能遵循 Agent Skills 规范，可接入 OpenClaw 和 hermes-agent 等代理运行时，并依赖 SenseNova 模型系列（如 SenseNova 6.7 Flash 和 SenseNova U1）。
zh.hot: 凭借 4873 颗星和今日新增 3 颗星，该仓库在 GitHub 趋势榜（JavaScript）排名第 9，因其提供开箱即用的办公 AI 技能，并集成到 Raccoon 产品中，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 开发者：希望快速构建 AI 办公助手或集成 SenseNova 技能到自己的代理中
办公自动化场景：需要自动生成 PPT、分析 Excel 数据、生成信息图或进行深度研究
产品团队：想利用 Raccoon 提供零配置的企业级办公 AI 能力

en.tag: Modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows
en.what: This repository provides a set of modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows. Each skill lives in its own directory and declares triggers, capabilities, and execution flow via a SKILL.md file, following the Agent Skills convention, usable standalone or composed into end-to-end workflows.
en.content: The repo includes skills for image generation & visualization, slide-deck (PPT) generation, Excel data analysis, and deep research, along with documentation of nearly 100 infographic generation examples.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, skills follow the Agent Skills spec, plug into agent runtimes like OpenClaw and hermes-agent, and rely on the SenseNova model family (e.g., SenseNova 6.7 Flash and SenseNova U1).
en.hot: With 4,873 stars and 3 new stars today, ranking #9 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript), it gains traction for offering ready-to-use office AI skills and integration into the Raccoon product.
uses: Developers: wanting to quickly build AI office assistants or integrate SenseNova skills into their agents
Office automation scenarios: needing to auto-generate PPTs, analyze Excel data, create infographics, or conduct deep research
Product teams: looking to leverage Raccoon for zero-setup enterprise-grade office AI capabilities

zh.tag: IBM 开源设计系统，提供 React 组件与设计资源
zh.what: Carbon 是 IBM 的开源设计系统，用于构建一致的产品和体验。它包含 React 组件库、Web Components、Sass 样式、设计令牌、图标和工具，帮助开发者快速搭建符合 IBM 设计语言的应用。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 monorepo，包含多个 npm 包，如 @carbon/react（React 组件）、@carbon/web-components（标准 Web Components）、@carbon/colors（颜色令牌）、@carbon/elements（设计元素）等，并提供文档、Storybook 和迁移指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 React 和 Web Components 标准，依赖 Sass 进行样式管理，并采用 monorepo 结构（可能使用 Lerna 或类似工具）管理多个包。
zh.hot: 虽然今日新增 star 不多，但作为 IBM 官方设计系统，拥有近万 star，是企业级应用设计的一致性和可访问性解决方案，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 企业级产品团队：需要统一设计语言和组件库来加速开发
React 开发者：使用 @carbon/react 快速构建符合 IBM 风格的界面
设计系统贡献者：参与开源设计系统的迭代和优化

en.tag: IBM's open-source design system with React components and design resources
en.what: Carbon is IBM's open-source design system for building consistent products and experiences. It includes React and web component libraries, Sass styles, design tokens, icons, and tooling to help developers build applications following IBM's design language.
en.content: The repository is a monorepo containing multiple npm packages such as @carbon/react (React components), @carbon/web-components (standards-based web components), @carbon/colors (color tokens), @carbon/elements (design elements), along with documentation, Storybook, and migration guides.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on React and Web Components standards, uses Sass for styling, and managed as a monorepo (likely with Lerna or similar tools) for multiple packages.
en.hot: Despite modest daily star growth, it's IBM's official design system with nearly 10k stars, offering consistency and accessibility for enterprise apps, and remains popular among developers.
uses: Enterprise product teams needing a unified design language and component library to speed up development
React developers using @carbon/react to quickly build IBM-styled interfaces
Design system contributors interested in iterating on an open-source design system

zh.tag: Airbnb 出品的 JavaScript 编码规范，前端团队必备
zh.what: 这是一份由 Airbnb 维护的 JavaScript 编码规范指南，涵盖了从基本类型到 ES6+ 的各个方面，旨在帮助开发者写出一致、可读且高质量的代码。它不仅是文档，还提供了配套的 ESLint 配置，可自动检查代码风格。
zh.content: 仓库包含指南的 Markdown 文档，按主题分为多个章节（如类型、引用、对象、函数等），并提供 ESLint 配置包（如 eslint-config-airbnb）及 React、CSS-in-JS 等扩展指南。
zh.stack: 主要基于 JavaScript（ES6+），依赖 Babel 和 ESLint，提供 eslint-config-airbnb 等 npm 包。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的 JavaScript 风格指南之一，拥有 148k+ star，长期霸榜，是无数前端项目的默认规范。今日新增 10 star，仍稳居日榜第二，足见其持久影响力。
uses: 前端开发者：学习并遵循 Airbnb 编码规范，提升代码质量与团队协作效率。
团队管理者：将 eslint-config-airbnb 集成到项目中，统一代码风格，减少 review 争论。
开源项目维护者：作为项目贡献指南的一部分，确保贡献者代码风格一致。
JavaScript 学习者：通过指南系统学习最佳实践，避免常见坑。

en.tag: Airbnb's JavaScript style guide, essential for front-end teams
en.what: A comprehensive JavaScript style guide maintained by Airbnb, covering everything from primitives to ES6+, aiming to help developers write consistent, readable, and high-quality code. It's not just documentation; it provides ESLint configs to enforce the style automatically.
en.content: The repo contains the guide as Markdown docs, organized into chapters (e.g., Types, References, Objects, Functions), plus ESLint config packages (like eslint-config-airbnb) and extended guides for React, CSS-in-JS, etc.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript (ES6+), relies on Babel and ESLint, and provides npm packages like eslint-config-airbnb.
en.hot: As one of the most popular JavaScript style guides, it has 148k+ stars and has long been the default standard for countless front-end projects. With 10 new stars today, it still ranks #2 on the daily trending, showing its enduring influence.
uses: Front-end developers: learn and follow Airbnb's coding standards to improve code quality and team collaboration.
Team leads: integrate eslint-config-airbnb into projects to unify code style and reduce review debates.
Open-source maintainers: use it as part of contribution guidelines to ensure consistent code style from contributors.
JavaScript learners: systematically learn best practices and avoid common pitfalls.

zh.tag: Atlassian 官方远程 MCP 服务器，连接 AI 与 Jira/Confluence 等
zh.what: 这是 Atlassian 官方推出的远程 MCP 服务器，让 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor、VS Code 等 AI 工具通过标准协议安全访问 Jira、Confluence、Jira Service Management、Bitbucket 和 Compass 的数据。它采用 OAuth 2.1 或 API 令牌认证，提供实时、云托管的桥接能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含服务器实现、配置示例（如 server.json）、认证文档、支持的产品集成说明，以及用于 MCP Registry 的元数据。
zh.stack: 主要基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 MCP SDK，支持 OAuth 2.1 和 API 令牌认证，部署在 Atlassian Cloud 上。
zh.hot: 作为 Atlassian 官方项目，它让企业级项目管理工具无缝接入主流 AI 助手，解决了 AI 工具与业务数据隔离的痛点。尽管 star 数不高（963），但日增 6 星并登上 JavaScript 趋势榜，说明开发者对官方 MCP 集成的关注度正在上升。
uses: 使用 Claude/ChatGPT 等 AI 助手查询 Jira 工单或 Confluence 文档的团队
在 Cursor/VS Code 中直接操作 Bitbucket 仓库或 Jira 任务的开发者
希望为内部 AI 工具接入 Atlassian 数据的企业平台团队
需要安全 OAuth 2.1 认证的 MCP 服务器集成场景

en.tag: Official remote MCP server bridging AI tools to Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and more
en.what: This is Atlassian's official remote MCP server that gives AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code secure, real-time access to Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, and Compass via the Model Context Protocol. It uses OAuth 2.1 or API tokens for authentication and is cloud-hosted.
en.content: The repository contains the server implementation, configuration examples (e.g., server.json), authentication docs, integration guides for supported products, and metadata for the MCP Registry.
en.stack: Built primarily with JavaScript/Node.js, uses the MCP SDK, supports OAuth 2.1 and API token auth, and is hosted on Atlassian Cloud.
en.hot: As an official Atlassian project, it seamlessly connects enterprise project management tools to mainstream AI assistants, solving the pain point of AI tools being isolated from business data. Despite modest stars (963), it gained 6 stars today and made the JavaScript trending list, indicating rising developer interest in official MCP integrations.
uses: Teams using AI assistants like Claude/ChatGPT to query Jira issues or Confluence docs
Developers who want to interact with Bitbucket repos or Jira tasks directly from Cursor/VS Code
Enterprise platform teams integrating Atlassian data into internal AI tools
Scenarios requiring secure OAuth 2.1 authentication for MCP server integrations

zh.tag: 为其余人打造的 Web 开发框架
zh.what: Svelte 是一种构建 Web 应用的新方式，它是一个编译器，将声明式组件转换为高效 JavaScript，精确更新 DOM。它旨在提供更简洁、更高效的开发体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Svelte 核心编译器、相关包（如 svelte 包）、文档、路线图和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖编译器技术，与标准 Web 技术（HTML/CSS/JS）集成。
zh.hot: Svelte 因其独特的编译时方法而广受欢迎，提供高性能和简洁的语法，拥有近 8.8 万星标，持续活跃在 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: Web 开发者寻求更高效、更简洁的框架来构建交互式 UI。
团队希望减少运行时开销并优化性能。
初学者想要一个学习曲线平缓的现代前端框架。

en.tag: Web development for the rest of us
en.what: Svelte is a new way to build web applications. It's a compiler that takes declarative components and converts them into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM, offering a cleaner and more performant development experience.
en.content: The repository contains the Svelte core compiler, related packages (e.g., the svelte package), documentation, roadmap, and contributing guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, leveraging compiler technology, and integrates with standard web technologies (HTML/CSS/JS).
en.hot: Svelte is popular for its unique compile-time approach, offering high performance and concise syntax, with nearly 88k stars and consistent presence on GitHub Trending.
uses: Web developers seeking a more efficient and concise framework for building interactive UIs.
Teams looking to reduce runtime overhead and optimize performance.
Beginners wanting a modern frontend framework with a gentle learning curve.

zh.tag: 轻量级日期时间库，Moment.js 的现代替代品
zh.what: Day.js 是一个极简的 JavaScript 库，用于解析、验证、操作和显示日期和时间。它提供与 Moment.js 兼容的 API，但体积仅 2kB，且不可变、可链式调用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码、多语言文档（含中文）、插件和测试。核心库提供日期解析、格式化、操作和查询功能，支持国际化。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript，无外部依赖，支持所有现代浏览器。可通过 npm 安装，提供 ES 模块和 CommonJS 等格式。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增 star 为 0，但累计 48k+ star 表明其作为 Moment.js 轻量替代品的持久热度，在 GitHub 趋势榜上仍占一席之地。
uses: 前端开发者：需要轻量日期处理库，避免 Moment.js 的体积负担
项目迁移：从 Moment.js 平滑迁移，API 兼容，降低迁移成本
国际化应用：支持多语言，适合全球化的产品

en.tag: Lightweight date-time library, modern alternative to Moment.js
en.what: Day.js is a minimalist JavaScript library that parses, validates, manipulates, and displays dates and times. It offers a Moment.js-compatible API but is only 2kB, immutable, and chainable.
en.content: The repository contains core library source, multi-language docs (including Chinese), plugins, and tests. The core provides date parsing, formatting, manipulation, and querying, with i18n support.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript with no external dependencies, supports all modern browsers. Installable via npm, offering ES modules and CommonJS formats.
en.hot: Despite 0 stars today, its 48k+ cumulative stars show enduring popularity as a lightweight Moment.js alternative, still trending on GitHub.
uses: Frontend developers needing a lightweight date library without Moment.js's bulk
Projects migrating from Moment.js with minimal changes due to API compatibility
Internationalized apps requiring multi-language support

zh.tag: Rust 桌面 UI 组件库，基于 GPUI 构建跨平台应用
zh.what: 这是一个基于 GPUI 的 Rust 桌面 UI 组件库，提供 60+ 跨平台组件，包括表格、列表、图表、代码编辑器等。它分为两层：gpui-component 提供开箱即用的样式组件，gpui-base 提供无样式的基础行为与基础设施，让开发者可以自由定制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的组件库源码、文档、示例和测试。核心是 gpui-component 和 gpui-base 两个 crate，以及用于展示的 website 目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 GPUI 框架，以及 Tree Sitter 用于语法高亮，支持 Markdown 渲染和虚拟化列表/表格。
zh.hot: 凭借丰富的组件、高性能和双层架构设计，在 Rust 社区迅速走红，今日新增 123 星，总星数达 12809，位列 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 7。
uses: Rust 开发者：希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，需要现成 UI 组件。
桌面应用团队：需要高性能表格、编辑器等复杂组件，同时希望保持设计一致性。
设计系统开发者：希望基于 gpui-base 构建自己的设计系统，同时复用交互逻辑。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library for building cross-platform apps with GPUI
en.what: This is a Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI, offering 60+ cross-platform components including tables, lists, charts, and a code editor. It is structured in two layers: gpui-component provides styled, ready-to-use components, while gpui-base offers unstyled behavior and infrastructure for full customization.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for the component library, documentation, examples, and tests. The core is two crates: gpui-component and gpui-base, along with a website directory for showcasing.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the GPUI framework, with Tree Sitter for syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering, and virtualized lists/tables.
en.hot: With its rich components, high performance, and two-layer architecture, it has quickly gained popularity in the Rust community, adding 123 stars today and reaching 12,809 total, ranking #7 on GitHub Trending for Rust today.
uses: Rust developers: Want to build cross-platform desktop apps with Rust and need ready-made UI components.
Desktop app teams: Need high-performance complex components like tables and editors while maintaining design consistency.
Design system developers: Want to build their own design system on gpui-base while reusing interaction logic.

zh.tag: 团队一体化协作工作台，AI 记忆贯穿所有模块
zh.what: Macro 是一个为团队打造的统一工作空间，将邮件、聊天、文档、任务、代理、通话和 CRM 集成在一个快速界面中，并共享团队级 AI 记忆。所有内容通过 @ 链接和双向图关联，可搜索，让团队和 AI 代理无需切换工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Macro 应用源代码，采用模块化 'blocks' 架构（如 Email、Messages、Tasks、Docs、Canvas、Agents 等），每个块都针对特定功能优化，但共享同一后端和双向图数据模型。
zh.stack: 前端使用 SolidJS，后端使用 Rust，文档基于 CRDT 实现实时协作，采用双向图存储交叉引用。
zh.hot: 今日新增 248 星，登上 Rust 日榜第二，因其重新定义团队工作软件的愿景，以及将 AI 代理深度集成到所有工作流中的创新设计。
uses: 初创公司或大型企业中的小团队，希望用一个系统替代 Slack、Linear、Notion 等多个工具。
技术团队需要高效沟通和任务管理，并希望 AI 代理辅助日常工作。
对 Rust 和 SolidJS 技术栈感兴趣的开发者，可学习其模块化架构和双向图实现。

en.tag: All-in-one team workspace with shared AI memory across email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, and CRM
en.what: Macro is a unified workspace for teams that integrates email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM into a single fast interface with shared team-level AI memory. Everything is @-linked and searchable via a bidirectional graph, so teams and agents never need to switch tools.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Macro app, built with modular 'blocks' (Email, Messages, Tasks, Docs, Canvas, Agents, etc.), each purpose-built but sharing a common backend and bidirectional graph data model.
en.stack: Frontend in SolidJS, backend in Rust, docs built on CRDTs for real-time collaboration, and cross-references stored as a bidirectional graph.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, ranking #2 on the Rust daily trending list, due to its ambitious vision to redesign team work software and its innovative integration of AI agents across all workflows.
uses: Startups or small teams in larger companies looking to replace multiple tools like Slack, Linear, Notion with one system.
Technical teams needing efficient communication and task management with AI agent assistance.
Developers interested in Rust and SolidJS, learning from its modular architecture and bidirectional graph implementation.

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面，自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面软件，开箱即用，无需配置。它允许用户完全控制自己的数据，支持自建中继/中转服务器，是 TeamViewer 的隐私友好替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端和服务器端代码，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 等多平台。提供二进制下载、Docker 构建方式，以及多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Flutter 用于跨平台 UI，使用 Sciter 或原生 GUI。服务器端基于 Rust 的异步网络框架。
zh.hot: 拥有 119k+ Stars，今日新增 121，因其完全开源、自托管、隐私安全且性能优异，成为 TeamViewer 等商业软件的热门替代。
uses: 个人用户：需要安全远程访问家庭或办公电脑
企业 IT：自建远程支持平台，保障数据隐私
开发者：定制远程桌面功能或集成到自有系统

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust, working out of the box with no configuration. It gives users full control over their data and supports self-hosted rendezvous/relay servers, serving as a privacy-friendly alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repository contains full client and server code, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and more. It offers binary downloads, Docker build instructions, and multilingual translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Flutter for cross-platform UI and Sciter or native GUI. The server side uses Rust's async networking framework.
en.hot: With 119k+ stars and 121 new today, it's a hot alternative to commercial software like TeamViewer due to its fully open-source, self-hosted, privacy-focused, and high-performance nature.
uses: Individual users: secure remote access to home or office computers
Enterprise IT: self-hosted remote support platform with data privacy

zh.tag: LLM 流量代理与协议翻译，让代理用上开源模型
