Power users who want to customize AI workflows with custom roles and rules.
Users migrating from deepseek-tui, with seamless config and session transfer.

zh.tag: 零知识跨链桥，去信任高安全，兼容 Cosmos 与 EVM
zh.what: Union 是一个基于零知识证明的跨链桥协议，旨在实现去信任、抗审查和极高安全性的资产转移与通用消息传递。它不依赖可信第三方、预言机或多签，而是通过共识验证和 IBC 协议实现跨链互操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个组件：节点实现 uniond、零知识证明器 galoisd、跨生态中继器 voyager、CosmWasm 和 EVM 智能合约、轻客户端、节点管理工具 unionvisor、水龙头、前端应用和 TypeScript SDK。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust，也涉及 Go、Solidity、TypeScript 等；依赖 CometBLS、Gnark、CosmWasm、Svelte、Astro 等。
zh.hot: 凭借零知识证明实现的高安全性和去信任特性，在 DeFi 领域备受关注，尽管本周新增 star 不多，但总星数已超 7.3 万，位列 Rust 周榜前列。
uses: DeFi 开发者：构建跨链资产转移和消息传递应用
Cosmos 生态项目：通过 IBC 与 EVM 链互操作
安全敏感场景：需要去信任桥接的机构或协议

en.tag: Trust-minimized ZK bridging protocol for Cosmos & EVM, high security
en.what: Union is a zero-knowledge based bridging protocol designed for trust-minimized, censorship-resistant, and highly secure asset transfers and general message passing. It relies on consensus verification and IBC, without trusted third parties, oracles, or multisig.
en.content: The repo contains multiple components: uniond node, galoisd prover, voyager relayer, CosmWasm and EVM contracts, light clients, unionvisor, faucet, frontend apps, and TypeScript SDK.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, with Go, Solidity, TypeScript; uses CometBLS, Gnark, CosmWasm, Svelte, Astro.
en.hot: Its high security and trust-minimized design via ZK proofs attract DeFi attention; despite modest weekly stars, total stars exceed 73k, ranking high in Rust weekly.
uses: DeFi developers building cross-chain asset transfers and messaging
Cosmos ecosystem projects needing EVM interoperability via IBC
Security-sensitive use cases requiring trust-minimized bridging

zh.tag: 基于以太坊的 Layer 2 区块链全组件仓库
zh.what: Base 是构建在以太坊上的 Layer 2 区块链，提供快速、低成本的交易。该仓库包含运行 Base 网络所需的全部组件，包括节点、智能合约和工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含节点客户端、智能合约、文档、以及用于安装和部署的工具（如 baseup 和 patched anvil/forge）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，基于 OP Stack（Optimism）构建，依赖 Ethereum 相关工具链。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增 star 不多，但作为 Coinbase 推出的 Layer 2 项目，Base 在开发者社区中拥有高关注度，其生态和文档完善。
uses: 开发者：在 Base 上部署去中心化应用（dApps）
节点运营者：运行 Base 节点以支持网络
区块链爱好者：研究 Layer 2 技术实现

en.tag: All components to run Base, an Ethereum L2 rollup
en.what: Base is a Layer 2 blockchain built on Ethereum, offering fast and cheap transactions. This repository contains all components needed to run the Base network, including nodes, smart contracts, and tooling.
en.content: The repository includes node clients, smart contracts, documentation, and tooling for installation and deployment (e.g., baseup and patched anvil/forge).
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the OP Stack (Optimism), and relies on Ethereum tooling.
en.hot: Despite modest daily star growth, Base, as Coinbase's Layer 2 project, enjoys high attention in the developer community due to its ecosystem and comprehensive docs.
uses: Developers: deploy dApps on Base
Node operators: run Base nodes to support the network
Blockchain enthusiasts: study Layer 2 implementation

zh.tag: 快速、省磁盘的 Node.js 包管理器
zh.what: pnpm 是一个快速且节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器，通过内容寻址存储来链接文件，避免重复下载。它支持 monorepo、严格的依赖访问控制，并可作为 Node.js 版本管理器使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 pnpm 的完整源码，包括 CLI、核心逻辑、文档和测试。还包含一个用 Rust 编写的实验性 CLI 移植版本（pacquet）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript/JavaScript 编写，但包含 Rust 组件（pacquet）。依赖 Node.js 生态，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.hot: pnpm 因其极快的速度和高效的磁盘空间利用而广受欢迎，star 数已达 36k，是 Node.js 开发者的首选包管理器之一。
uses: Node.js 开发者：替代 npm/yarn 进行依赖管理，节省磁盘空间并提升安装速度。
Monorepo 项目：利用其 workspace 支持，高效管理多包仓库。
CI/CD 环境：快速安装依赖，减少构建时间。
需要严格依赖隔离的项目：确保包只能访问其声明的依赖。

en.tag: Fast, disk space efficient package manager for Node.js
en.what: pnpm is a fast and disk space efficient package manager for Node.js. It links files from a single content-addressable storage to avoid duplication. It supports monorepos, strict dependency access control, and can act as a Node.js version manager.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of pnpm, including the CLI, core logic, documentation, and tests. It also includes an experimental Rust port of the CLI called pacquet.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript/JavaScript, with a Rust component (pacquet). Depends on the Node.js ecosystem and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: pnpm is popular for its speed and disk space efficiency, with over 36k stars, making it a top choice among Node.js developers.
uses: Node.js developers: replace npm/yarn for dependency management, saving disk space and improving install speed.
Monorepo projects: leverage workspace support to efficiently manage multi-package repositories.
CI/CD environments: fast dependency installation reduces build times.
Projects requiring strict dependency isolation: ensure packages only access declared dependencies.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编程代理会话搜索、分析与成本追踪工具
zh.what: AgentsView 是一个本地优先的工具，用于浏览、搜索和追踪所有 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等 20 多种）的会话记录和成本。它提供统一的分析仪表盘和 token 使用统计，所有数据都存储在本地，无需账户。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Go 编写的命令行工具和桌面应用，提供 Web UI 仪表盘、SQLite 数据库、守护进程管理，以及用于同步和查询会话数据的 CLI 命令。支持通过 Docker 运行，并可从 S3 兼容存储同步会话。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 SQLite 存储会话数据，支持 Docker 部署，并集成 S3 兼容对象存储用于远程会话同步。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程代理的普及，开发者需要统一管理多个代理的会话和成本。AgentsView 提供本地优先的解决方案，今日新增 129 星，总星数达 5026，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）第 1 名。
uses: 使用多个 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望统一查看会话记录和 token 消耗。
团队或企业需要追踪 AI 工具使用成本，优化预算分配。
注重隐私的用户，希望所有数据本地存储，不依赖云端服务。
需要分析代理使用模式，提升编码效率的开发者。

en.tag: Local-first session search, analytics, and cost tracking for AI coding agents
en.what: AgentsView is a local-first tool for browsing, searching, and tracking sessions and costs across all your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, and 20+ others). It provides a unified analytics dashboard and token usage statistics, with all data stored locally and no account required.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based CLI tool and desktop app, featuring a web UI dashboard, SQLite database, daemon management, and CLI commands for syncing and querying session data. It can be run via Docker and supports syncing sessions from S3-compatible storage.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relies on SQLite for session storage, supports Docker deployment, and integrates with S3-compatible object storage for remote session sync.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need a unified way to manage sessions and costs across multiple agents. AgentsView offers a local-first solution, gaining 129 stars today and reaching 5026 total, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding agents who want a unified view of sessions and token usage.
Teams or enterprises needing to track AI tool costs and optimize budget allocation.
Privacy-conscious users who want all data stored locally without cloud dependencies.
Developers who want to analyze agent usage patterns to improve coding efficiency.

zh.tag: 开源 RAG 引擎，融合 Agent 能力，为 LLM 构建上下文层
zh.what: RAGFlow 是一个领先的开源检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，将前沿的 RAG 技术与 Agent 能力相结合，为大型语言模型（LLM）提供高质量的上下文层。它支持深度文档理解、基于模板的文本切片、可配置的 Agent 工作流，以及基于引用的可追溯回答，确保输出的准确性和可验证性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 RAGFlow 系统，包括后端服务（Go 编写）、前端 Web 界面、Agent 工作流编排、文档解析与索引模块，以及 Docker 部署配置。提供多语言 README、云服务入口和详细文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发后端，前端基于 Web 技术；依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，集成多种 LLM 和向量数据库，支持深度文档理解与 RAG 流程。
zh.hot: RAGFlow 凭借其将 RAG 与 Agent 结合的创新理念，以及强大的文档处理能力和可追溯回答，在 GitHub 上获得 87k+ 星标，今日新增 85 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 20 名，持续受到开发者社区的高度关注。
uses: 企业知识库构建：利用 RAGFlow 搭建内部文档问答系统，提升信息检索效率。
AI 应用开发者：集成 RAGFlow 作为 LLM 应用的上下文层，增强回答准确性和可追溯性。
研究机构：用于学术文献的深度解析和知识抽取，辅助研究分析。
开源爱好者：学习 RAG 与 Agent 结合的架构设计，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: Open-source RAG engine fusing RAG with Agent capabilities for LLM context layer
en.what: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs. It supports deep document understanding, template-based chunking, configurable Agent workflows, and citation-based traceable answers, ensuring accuracy and verifiability.
en.content: The repository contains the full RAGFlow system, including backend services (written in Go), frontend web UI, Agent workflow orchestration, document parsing and indexing modules, and Docker deployment configurations. It provides multi-language READMEs, cloud service entry, and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Backend primarily developed in Go, frontend based on web technologies; relies on Docker for containerized deployment, integrates multiple LLMs and vector databases, supporting deep document understanding and RAG pipelines.
en.hot: RAGFlow has gained 87k+ stars on GitHub due to its innovative fusion of RAG with Agent capabilities, powerful document processing, and traceable answers. With 85 new stars today, it ranks #20 on the Go trending list, maintaining high attention from the developer community.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Build internal document Q&A systems to improve information retrieval efficiency.
AI app developers: Integrate RAGFlow as a context layer for LLM applications, enhancing answer accuracy and traceability.
Research institutions: Use for deep parsing and knowledge extraction of academic literature to aid research analysis.
Open-source enthusiasts: Learn the architecture of combining RAG with Agent and contribute to the community.

zh.tag: Go 语言现代 CLI 应用开发库
zh.what: Cobra 是一个用于构建现代 CLI 应用的 Go 库，提供子命令、POSIX 兼容标志、嵌套子命令、智能提示、自动帮助生成、shell 自动补全等功能。它被 Kubernetes、Hugo、GitHub CLI 等众多知名项目使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cobra 库的源码、文档、示例以及使用 Cobra 的项目列表。核心是 command.go、flag.go 等文件，提供命令、参数和标志的处理逻辑。
zh.stack: 纯 Go 实现，无外部依赖，可选集成 viper 以支持 12-factor 应用配置。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 生态中最流行的 CLI 库之一，拥有 4.4 万 star，被 Kubernetes 等重量级项目采用，今日新增 4 star 仍位列 Go 趋势榜第三。
uses: Go 开发者构建命令行工具，如 kubectl、gh 等
需要子命令和复杂标志解析的 CLI 应用
希望自动生成帮助文档和 shell 补全的开发者

en.tag: A library for creating powerful modern CLI applications in Go
en.what: Cobra is a Go library for building modern CLI applications, offering subcommands, POSIX-compliant flags, nested subcommands, intelligent suggestions, automatic help generation, shell autocompletion, and more. It is used by many well-known projects like Kubernetes, Hugo, and GitHub CLI.
en.content: The repository contains the Cobra library source code, documentation, examples, and a list of projects using Cobra. Core files like command.go and flag.go handle commands, arguments, and flags.
en.stack: Pure Go implementation with no external dependencies, optional integration with viper for 12-factor app configuration.
en.hot: As one of the most popular CLI libraries in the Go ecosystem, it has 44k stars and is adopted by heavyweight projects like Kubernetes. It gained 4 stars today and ranks #3 on the Go trending list.
uses: Go developers building CLI tools like kubectl, gh
CLI apps needing subcommands and complex flag parsing
Developers wanting auto-generated help and shell completion

zh.tag: Go 语言官方仓库，简单可靠高效的编程语言
zh.what: Go 是一种开源编程语言，旨在简化构建简单、可靠且高效的软件。该仓库是 Go 语言的官方源码仓库，包含编译器、标准库和工具链。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言的完整源码，包括编译器（cmd）、标准库（src）、文档（doc）和测试等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言编写，部分工具使用 C 语言（如汇编器和链接器）。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 语言的官方仓库，持续获得大量关注，star 数高达 135k，今日新增 38，稳居趋势榜。
uses: 开发者学习 Go 语言源码和实现细节
编译器工程师贡献代码或研究后端技术
企业评估或采用 Go 语言进行项目开发
教育机构用于教学和学术研究

en.tag: Official Go language repo: simple, reliable, efficient programming
en.what: Go is an open-source programming language designed for building simple, reliable, and efficient software. This repo is the official source for the Go language, including the compiler, standard library, and toolchain.
en.content: The repo contains the complete source code of Go, including the compiler (cmd), standard library (src), documentation (doc), and tests.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with some tools in C (e.g., assembler and linker).
en.hot: As the official repository of the Go language, it consistently garners massive attention with 135k stars, adding 38 today, and ranking on the trending list.
uses: Developers learning Go source code and implementation details
Compiler engineers contributing code or researching backend technology
Enterprises evaluating or adopting Go for project development
Educational institutions for teaching and academic research

zh.tag: 基础设施即代码的行业标准工具
zh.what: Terraform 是一个开源的基础设施即代码工具，允许用户使用声明式配置语言定义和管理云及本地基础设施。它通过执行计划和资源图确保变更安全、可预测，并支持变更自动化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Terraform 核心源码，包括命令行工具、配置解析、状态管理、资源图构建等。还包括文档、教程链接和认证信息。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 HashiCorp 自家的库（如 HCL）以及各种云服务商的 SDK。
zh.hot: 作为 IaC 领域的标杆，Terraform 拥有近 5 万星标，持续活跃，是云原生和 DevOps 社区不可或缺的工具。
uses: DevOps 工程师：自动化云资源部署与管理
平台团队：构建可复用的基础设施模块
云架构师：设计跨云基础设施蓝图
学习基础设施即代码的开发者

en.tag: Industry-standard Infrastructure-as-Code tool
en.what: Terraform is an open-source infrastructure-as-code tool that lets users define and manage cloud and on-premises infrastructure using declarative configuration. It ensures safe and predictable changes through execution plans and resource graphs, and supports change automation.
en.content: The repository contains Terraform core source code, including CLI, configuration parsing, state management, resource graph construction, etc. It also includes documentation, tutorial links, and certification info.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on HashiCorp's own libraries (e.g., HCL) and various cloud provider SDKs.
en.hot: As a benchmark in IaC, Terraform has nearly 50k stars, remains highly active, and is indispensable in cloud-native and DevOps communities.
uses: DevOps engineers: automate cloud resource deployment and management
Platform teams: build reusable infrastructure modules
Cloud architects: design multi-cloud infrastructure blueprints
Developers learning infrastructure as code

zh.tag: 高性能极简 Go Web 框架，路由与中间件生态丰富
zh.what: Echo 是一个基于 Go 标准库 net/http 的高性能、可扩展且极简的 Web 框架。它提供了快速的路由器、请求绑定、中间件和集中式错误处理，帮助开发者构建健壮且可扩展的 RESTful API。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架源码、文档、示例和测试，核心功能包括优化路由、分组 API、可扩展中间件、数据绑定、模板渲染、自动 TLS 和 HTTP/2 支持。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 标准库 net/http，使用 radix-tree 路由，支持多种模板引擎和验证器，依赖少，易于定制。
zh.hot: Echo 是 Go 社区最受欢迎的 Web 框架之一，拥有 32k+ star，今日新增 6 星，持续活跃维护，v5 版本稳定，深受开发者信赖。
uses: Go 后端开发者构建 RESTful API 和微服务
需要高性能路由和丰富中间件的 Web 应用
希望基于标准库但简化开发的团队
学习 Go Web 框架设计的开发者

en.tag: High-performance, minimalist Go web framework with rich middleware ecosystem
en.what: Echo is a high-performance, extensible, minimalist Go web framework built on Go's standard net/http. It provides a fast router, request binding, middleware, and centralized error handling to help developers build robust and scalable RESTful APIs.
en.content: The repository contains framework source code, documentation, examples, and tests. Key features include optimized routing, API grouping, extensible middleware, data binding, template rendering, automatic TLS, and HTTP/2 support.
en.stack: Built on Go's standard net/http, uses a radix-tree router, supports multiple template engines and validators, minimal dependencies, and highly customizable.
en.hot: Echo is one of the most popular Go web frameworks with 32k+ stars, gaining 6 stars today, actively maintained with a stable v5 release, trusted by developers.
uses: Go backend developers building RESTful APIs and microservices
Web applications requiring high-performance routing and rich middleware
Teams wanting to simplify development while staying close to the standard library
Developers learning Go web framework design

zh.tag: 一站式开源 DevOps 平台，集代码托管、CI/CD、开发环境与制品库于一体
zh.what: Harness 开源版是一个端到端的开发者平台，整合了源代码管理、CI/CD 流水线、托管开发环境（Gitspaces）和制品仓库。它是 Drone 的下一代演进，在持续集成基础上扩展了更多功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台代码，支持通过 Docker 镜像快速本地部署，并提供了开发指南和文档。包含主要分支和 Drone 功能分支，便于迁移和持续开发。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能涉及 Node.js，依赖 protobuf 等工具。通过 Docker 容器化部署，使用卷存储数据。
zh.hot: 作为 Drone 的继任者，Harness 开源版提供了一体化 DevOps 能力，吸引了大量关注。今日新增 104 星，总星数近 3.8 万，在 Go 趋势榜上排名第 11。
uses: 开发团队：需要一体化 DevOps 平台，简化代码托管、CI/CD 和开发环境管理
Drone 用户：希望迁移到功能更全面的平台，同时保持流水线兼容性
自托管爱好者：希望通过 Docker 快速部署自己的 DevOps 基础设施
DevOps 工程师：探索开源工具，用于构建端到端的开发工作流

en.tag: All-in-one open-source DevOps platform with code hosting, CI/CD, dev environments, and artifact registries
en.what: Harness Open Source is an end-to-end developer platform that integrates source control management, CI/CD pipelines, hosted developer environments (Gitspaces), and artifact registries. It is the next evolution of Drone, extending beyond continuous integration with additional capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform code, supports quick local deployment via Docker image, and includes development guides and documentation. It has a main branch and a Drone feature branch for migration and ongoing development.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with possible Node.js for frontend, and dependencies like protobuf. Deployed via Docker containers, using volumes for data storage.
en.hot: As the successor to Drone, Harness Open Source offers an integrated DevOps platform, attracting significant attention. With 104 stars added today and nearly 38k total stars, it ranks #11 on the Go trending list.
uses: Development teams: needing an integrated DevOps platform to streamline code hosting, CI/CD, and dev environment management
Drone users: looking to migrate to a more comprehensive platform while maintaining pipeline compatibility
Self-hosting enthusiasts: wanting to quickly deploy their own DevOps infrastructure via Docker
DevOps engineers: exploring open-source tools to build end-to-end development workflows

zh.tag: AI 交易终端，策略即语言模型
zh.what: NOFX 是一个开源 AI 交易终端，支持美股、大宗商品、外汇和加密货币。它让交易者运行一个持续循环：读取市场结构、决策、执行、记录推理，同时 Go 运行时强制执行模型无法覆盖的硬风险限制。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端、Web 前端（位于 web/ 目录）、安装脚本、文档及多语言翻译。提供 Autopilot 模式，AI 自动扫描市场并交易，所有决策实时显示在仪表盘上。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 构建运行时，前端为 Web 界面，支持多种交易所（如 Binance、Hyperliquid），集成 AI 模型，使用 USDC 作为费用和交易资金。
zh.hot: 凭借 12.7k 星标和日增 15 星，NOFX 因将 AI 代理与严格风险控制结合而受到关注，提供可自由组合模型、交易所和策略的开源交易终端，并带有公开排行榜。
uses: 量化交易者：希望利用 AI 模型自动执行交易策略并实时监控。
开发者：对 Go 和 AI 集成感兴趣，可扩展或定制交易终端。
加密货币投资者：在 Hyperliquid 等交易所进行自动化交易。
研究用途：比较不同 AI 模型在真实市场中的表现。

en.tag: AI trading terminal where the strategy is a language model
en.what: NOFX is an open-source AI trading terminal for US stocks, commodities, forex, and crypto. It lets traders run a continuous loop of reading market structure, deciding, executing, and recording reasoning, while a Go runtime enforces hard risk limits the model cannot override.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend, a web frontend (in web/), an install script, docs, and multi-language translations. It offers an Autopilot mode where the AI scans the market and trades automatically, with all decisions shown on the dashboard in real time.
en.stack: Built primarily with Go for the runtime, with a web frontend. Supports multiple exchanges (e.g., Binance, Hyperliquid), integrates AI models, and uses USDC for fees and trading funds.
en.hot: With 12.7k stars and 15 new stars today, NOFX gains attention for combining AI agents with strict risk controls, offering an open-source trading terminal with freely composable models, exchanges, and strategies, plus a public leaderboard.
uses: Quant traders: want to automate trading strategies with AI models and monitor in real time.
Developers: interested in Go and AI integration, can extend or customize the terminal.
Crypto investors: automate trading on exchanges like Hyperliquid.
Research: compare performance of different AI models in live markets.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的操作系统，让代理协作自动化
zh.what: CompozyOS 是一个为 AI 代理设计的操作系统，它将你已有的代理 CLI（如 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor）整合成一个团队，让它们分工协作、自动运行任务并共享项目记忆。你可以在浏览器中管理所有操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心守护进程、Web 界面（packages/site）、CLI 工具，以及文档和迁移指南。支持通过 cron、webhook 和触发器自动化任务，并提供审批、权限和可观测性功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 SQLite 存储，支持 ACP 兼容的代理 CLI，并提供 Web、CLI、HTTP/SSE、UDS、MCP 等多种接口。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的普及，开发者需要更高效地管理和协作多个代理。CompozyOS 提供了一体化的解决方案，将代理编排、自动化和监督集成到一个产品中，因此迅速获得关注，在 GitHub 趋势榜上排名靠前。
uses: 开发者：希望将多个 AI 代理集成到统一工作流中，提升效率。
技术运维人员：需要自动化代理任务并监控其运行状态。
团队协作：让不同代理分工合作，共享项目记忆，适合复杂项目。

en.tag: An operating system for AI agents, turning agent CLIs into a collaborative team
en.what: CompozyOS is an operating system for AI agents, integrating your existing agent CLIs (like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor) into a team that splits work, automates tasks, and shares project memory. You can control everything from a browser.
en.content: The repo includes a Go-based daemon, a web shell (packages/site), CLI tools, and documentation with migration guides. It supports automation via cron, webhooks, and triggers, along with approvals, permissions, and observability.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, uses SQLite for storage, supports ACP-compatible agent CLIs, and offers interfaces like Web, CLI, HTTP/SSE, UDS, and MCP.
en.hot: As AI agents become mainstream, developers need better ways to manage and collaborate across multiple agents. CompozyOS offers an all-in-one solution for orchestrating, automating, and supervising agents, quickly gaining traction and ranking high on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers: Want to integrate multiple AI agents into a unified workflow for efficiency.
Technical operators: Need to automate agent tasks and monitor their runtime status.
Team collaboration: Enable different agents to work together and share project memory, ideal for complex projects.

zh.tag: 一键运行开源大模型的本地推理平台
zh.what: Ollama 是一个本地运行开源大模型的工具，支持 Kimi-K2.6、GLM-5.2、DeepSeek、Qwen、Gemma 等众多模型。它提供简洁的命令行界面和 REST API，让用户轻松下载、运行和管理模型，并可与 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 代理集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ollama 的 Go 源码、安装脚本（macOS/Windows/Linux）、Docker 镜像、Python/JavaScript 客户端库，以及完整的 CLI 和 API 文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 llama.cpp 推理引擎，提供 REST API 和官方 Python/JavaScript SDK。
zh.hot: Star 数高达 178k，今日新增 84，持续霸榜。Ollama 让本地部署大模型变得极其简单，成为开发者体验开源模型的首选工具。
uses: 开发者本地快速体验和测试开源大模型
隐私敏感场景下离线运行 AI 助手
将本地模型接入 Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理
通过 REST API 构建自定义 AI 应用

en.tag: Run open-source LLMs locally with one command
en.what: Ollama is a tool for running open-source LLMs locally, supporting models like Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Gemma. It offers a simple CLI and REST API to easily download, run, and manage models, and integrates with AI agents like Claude Code and Codex.
en.content: The repo contains Ollama's Go source code, install scripts for macOS/Windows/Linux, Docker image, Python/JavaScript client libraries, and full CLI/API documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on the llama.cpp inference engine, with a REST API and official Python/JavaScript SDKs.
en.hot: With 178k stars and 84 new today, Ollama remains a trending favorite. It simplifies local LLM deployment, making it the go-to tool for developers exploring open models.
uses: Developers quickly trying and testing open LLMs locally
Running AI assistants offline for privacy-sensitive scenarios
Connecting local models to coding agents like Claude Code and Codex
Building custom AI apps via the REST API

zh.tag: 终端里的 AI 编程助手，已迁移至 Crush
zh.what: OpenCode 是一个基于 Go 的终端 AI 编程助手，提供交互式 TUI，支持多种 AI 提供商，能帮助开发者完成编码、调试等任务。项目已归档，后续开发转移到 Crush。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源码、安装脚本、配置示例等，提供 TUI 界面、会话管理、工具集成、LSP 支持等功能。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言，基于 Bubble Tea 构建 TUI，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等多家 AI 提供商，使用 SQLite 存储数据。
zh.hot: 尽管已归档，但因其强大的终端 AI 编程体验和广泛的 AI 提供商支持，仍获得 1.3 万星标，今日新增 9 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 11。
uses: 开发者：在终端中直接获得 AI 编程辅助，无需离开命令行
AI 爱好者：体验多种 AI 模型（如 Gemini、Claude）在编码场景的应用
寻求替代 Claude Code 等工具的用户：OpenCode 提供了快速、可定制的选择

en.tag: Terminal-based AI coding agent, now moved to Crush
en.what: OpenCode is a Go-based terminal AI coding assistant with an interactive TUI, supporting multiple AI providers to help developers with coding and debugging. The project is archived, with development continuing under Crush.
en.content: The repository contains Go source code, install scripts, and config examples, featuring a TUI, session management, tool integration, and LSP support.
en.stack: Built with Go, using Bubble Tea for TUI, supporting multiple AI providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and using SQLite for storage.
en.hot: Despite being archived, it still holds 13.6k stars due to its powerful terminal AI coding experience and broad AI provider support, with 9 new stars today, ranking #11 on Go trending.
uses: Developers: get AI coding assistance directly in the terminal without leaving the command line
AI enthusiasts: experience multiple AI models (e.g., Gemini, Claude) in coding scenarios
Users seeking alternatives to tools like Claude Code: OpenCode offers a fast, customizable option

zh.tag: 开源监控系统与时间序列数据库
zh.what: Prometheus 是一个系统和服务监控系统，定期从配置的目标收集指标，评估规则表达式，展示结果，并在满足条件时触发警报。它采用多维数据模型和强大的 PromQL 查询语言，支持服务发现和多种可视化方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Prometheus 的完整源代码、文档、架构图、安装指南以及 CI/CD 配置。主要组件包括指标采集、存储、查询引擎、告警管理和 Web UI。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖包括 HTTP 服务、时间序列存储、PromQL 解析器，以及用于服务发现的各类客户端库。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 的旗舰项目，Prometheus 已成为云原生监控的事实标准，拥有 65,710 颗星，并持续活跃在 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 运维工程师：监控服务器、容器和云服务的性能指标
SRE 团队：实现高可用告警和故障排查
开发者：为应用自定义指标并集成 Grafana 可视化

en.tag: Open-source monitoring system and time series database
en.what: Prometheus is a systems and service monitoring system that collects metrics from configured targets at intervals, evaluates rule expressions, displays results, and triggers alerts when conditions are met. It features a multi-dimensional data model and powerful PromQL query language, with service discovery and multiple visualization modes.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, architecture diagrams, installation guides, and CI/CD configurations for Prometheus. Key components include metric scraping, storage, query engine, alerting, and web UI.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, with dependencies on HTTP server, time series storage, PromQL parser, and various client libraries for service discovery.
en.hot: As a flagship CNCF project, Prometheus has become the de facto standard for cloud-native monitoring, with 65,710 stars and ongoing presence on GitHub trending.
uses: Ops engineers: monitor performance metrics of servers, containers, and cloud services
SRE teams: implement high-availability alerting and incident troubleshooting
Developers: define custom metrics for applications and integrate with Grafana for visualization

zh.tag: 生产级容器编排与调度平台
zh.what: Kubernetes 是一个开源系统，用于管理跨多台主机的容器化应用，提供部署、维护和扩展应用的基本机制。它基于 Google 内部大规模运行生产负载的 Borg 系统经验，并结合社区最佳实践。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kubernetes 的核心代码，包括 kube-apiserver、kube-controller-manager、kube-scheduler、kubelet 等组件，以及构建、测试和开发文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 etcd 作为存储，支持 Docker 和 containerd 等容器运行时。
zh.hot: 作为云原生计算基金会（CNCF）的旗舰项目，Kubernetes 已成为容器编排的事实标准，拥有超过 12 万 star，持续吸引开发者和企业采用。
uses: 运维工程师：部署和管理生产级容器化应用
开发人员：在本地或云环境中开发、测试微服务
平台团队：构建内部云原生平台或 PaaS
学习容器编排：了解分布式系统设计的最佳实践

en.tag: Production-grade container orchestration and scheduling platform
en.what: Kubernetes is an open-source system for managing containerized applications across multiple hosts, providing basic mechanisms for deployment, maintenance, and scaling. It builds on Google's experience running production workloads at scale with Borg, combined with community best practices.
en.content: The repository contains the core Kubernetes code, including components like kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler, kubelet, along with build, test, and development documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relies on etcd for storage, and supports container runtimes like Docker and containerd.
en.hot: As the flagship project of CNCF, Kubernetes has become the de facto standard for container orchestration, with over 120k stars, continuously attracting developers and enterprises.
uses: DevOps engineers: deploy and manage production containerized applications
Developers: develop and test microservices locally or in the cloud
Platform teams: build internal cloud-native platforms or PaaS
Learners: understand best practices in distributed systems design

zh.tag: 高性能自托管邮件列表与简报管理器
zh.what: listmonk 是一个独立、自托管的简报和邮件列表管理器，速度快、功能丰富，打包为单个二进制文件。它使用 PostgreSQL 作为数据存储，提供现代化的仪表盘界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端和 Vue 与 Buefy 编写的前端，提供 Docker 镜像和二进制文件两种安装方式，并附带示例 docker-compose.yml。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go，前端使用 Vue 和 Buefy，数据库为 PostgreSQL，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 因其高性能、自托管和单二进制部署的便利性而受到欢迎，今日新增 40 星，总星数达 22803，位列 Go 趋势榜第 9。
uses: 需要自托管邮件简报服务的个人或企业，避免依赖第三方服务
开发者希望快速部署邮件列表管理，使用 Docker 或二进制文件
注重性能和资源占用，希望使用单一二进制文件运行的应用场景

en.tag: High-performance, self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager
en.what: listmonk is a standalone, self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager that is fast, feature-rich, and packed into a single binary. It uses PostgreSQL as its data store and offers a modern dashboard.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend and a Vue with Buefy frontend, offering both Docker images and binary releases for installation, along with a sample docker-compose.yml.
en.stack: Backend in Go, frontend in Vue with Buefy, PostgreSQL database, Docker deployment supported.
en.hot: Popular for its high performance, self-hosting capability, and ease of deployment as a single binary, gaining 40 stars today and reaching 22,803 total, ranking 9th on the Go trending list.
uses: Individuals or businesses needing self-hosted newsletter services to avoid third-party dependencies
Developers who want to quickly deploy a mailing list manager using Docker or binary
Use cases where performance and low resource footprint are important, with a single binary

zh.tag: 开源基础设施即代码工具，Terraform 的替代品
zh.what: OpenTofu 是一个开源的基础设施即代码工具，允许你以声明方式管理云基础设施。它可以安全高效地构建、变更和版本化基础设施，支持现有主流服务提供商和自定义内部解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenTofu 的源代码、文档、贡献指南和社区活动信息。核心功能包括基础设施即代码、执行计划、资源图和变更自动化。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 OpenSSF Best Practices 等标准，支持多种云服务提供商。
zh.hot: 作为 Terraform 的社区驱动开源替代品，OpenTofu 在基础设施即代码领域持续受到关注，拥有近 3 万 star，今日新增 10 个，位列 Go 语言日榜第 15 名。
uses: 云基础设施工程师：使用声明式配置管理多云环境
DevOps 团队：实现基础设施的版本控制和自动化变更
开源爱好者：参与社区驱动的 Terraform 替代品开发

en.tag: Open-source Infrastructure as Code tool, a Terraform alternative
en.what: OpenTofu is an open-source Infrastructure as Code tool that lets you declaratively manage your cloud infrastructure. It safely and efficiently builds, changes, and versions infrastructure, supporting existing popular service providers and custom in-house solutions.
en.content: The repository contains OpenTofu's source code, documentation, contribution guide, and community event info. Key features include Infrastructure as Code, execution plans, resource graph, and change automation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, adhering to standards like OpenSSF Best Practices, and supporting multiple cloud providers.
en.hot: As a community-driven open-source alternative to Terraform, OpenTofu continues to gain traction in the IaC space, with nearly 30k stars and 10 new stars today, ranking #15 on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Cloud infrastructure engineers: manage multi-cloud environments with declarative configs
DevOps teams: version control and automate infrastructure changes
Open-source enthusiasts: contribute to a community-driven Terraform alternative

zh.tag: 终端里的 Git 可视化神器
zh.what: lazygit 是一个运行在终端里的 Git 图形化界面，让你不用记命令就能完成提交、分支、合并等操作。它把 Git 操作变成直观的按键和面板，极大提升日常开发效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 程序，提供交互式 TUI，支持文件暂存、提交、分支管理、冲突解决等，并配有演示 GIF 和详细文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，依赖 gocui 等终端 UI 库，支持跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows），可通过 Homebrew 等包管理器安装。
zh.hot: 拥有 81k+ stars，今日新增 54，稳居 Go 趋势榜前列。因其简单易用、大幅提升 Git 操作效率，成为开发者必备工具。
uses: 日常使用 Git 的开发者，希望提高操作效率
刚入门 Git 的新手，想避开复杂命令行
需要快速可视化处理冲突的团队协作场景

en.tag: A simple terminal UI for git commands
en.what: lazygit is a terminal-based graphical interface for Git, allowing you to perform commits, branching, merging, and more without memorizing commands. It turns Git operations into intuitive keybindings and panels, greatly boosting daily development efficiency.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-written CLI program with an interactive TUI, supporting file staging, committing, branch management, conflict resolution, and includes demo GIFs and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging terminal UI libraries like gocui, cross-platform (macOS/Linux/Windows), installable via package managers like Homebrew.
en.hot: With 81k+ stars and 54 new today, it consistently ranks high on the Go trending list. Its simplicity and efficiency boost make it an essential tool for developers.
uses: Developers who use Git daily and want to improve efficiency
Beginners new to Git who want to avoid complex command lines
Team collaboration scenarios needing quick visual conflict resolution

zh.tag: 自托管虚拟浏览器，WebRTC 实时协作
zh.what: Neko 是一个自托管的虚拟浏览器，运行在 Docker 中，通过 WebRTC 技术提供低延迟的浏览器访问。它允许用户在隔离环境中安全、私密地浏览网页和运行应用，并支持多人同时访问，适合团队协作、观看派对和远程演示。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Docker 镜像、配置示例、文档和 Web 客户端，支持自定义浏览器（如 Firefox、Chromium）和多种部署选项。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，依赖 WebRTC（如 Pion）、Docker 容器化，前端可能涉及 React 等 Web 技术。
zh.hot: Neko 因其自托管、隐私保护和多人协作能力而受到欢迎，22k+ 的 Star 数反映了其作为虚拟浏览器解决方案的广泛需求。
uses: 开发者：测试 Web 应用或进行远程调试
注重隐私的用户：安全、隔离的浏览环境
团队/组织：共享浏览器访问，协作项目
娱乐：举办观看派对或互动演示

en.tag: Self-hosted virtual browser with WebRTC for real-time collaboration
en.what: Neko is a self-hosted virtual browser that runs in Docker and uses WebRTC to provide low-latency browser access. It allows users to securely and privately browse the web and run applications in an isolated environment, with support for multiple concurrent users, making it ideal for team collaboration, watch parties, and remote presentations.
en.content: The repository includes Docker images, configuration examples, documentation, and a web client, with support for custom browsers (e.g., Firefox, Chromium) and various deployment options.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging WebRTC (e.g., Pion) and Docker for containerization; the frontend may involve web technologies like React.
en.hot: Neko's popularity stems from its self-hosting, privacy, and multi-user collaboration features; the 22k+ stars reflect the broad demand for such a virtual browser solution.
uses: Developers: test web apps or remote debugging
Privacy-conscious users: secure, isolated browsing
Teams/organizations: shared browser access for collaboration
Entertainment: hosting watch parties or interactive presentations

zh.tag: Windows 专属 Node.js 版本管理器，Go 编写
zh.what: nvm-windows 是微软、npm 和谷歌推荐的 Windows 平台 Node.js 版本管理工具，允许用户轻松安装、切换和管理多个 Node.js 版本。它不同于 Mac/Linux 的 nvm，采用独立的设计理念，专为 Windows 环境优化。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、安装程序（exe）、命令行工具以及详细的文档和 Wiki。项目还提供了稳定的 v1.1.12 版本和过渡性的 v1.2.x 版本，并正在开发继任者 Runtime。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言编写，依赖 Windows API 进行系统集成，通过 npm 和 Node.js 生态进行版本管理。
zh.hot: 作为 Windows 上最流行的 Node.js 版本管理器，拥有超过 47k 星标，本周新增 102 星，持续受到开发者信赖。其推荐地位和活跃开发（如 Runtime 项目）使其保持热度。
uses: Windows 开发者需要同时维护多个 Node.js 项目的场景，快速切换版本
前端或全栈工程师在 Windows 环境下进行本地开发，确保环境一致性
DevOps 或 CI/CD 流程中，在 Windows 构建服务器上管理 Node.js 版本

en.tag: Node.js version manager for Windows, written in Go
en.what: nvm-windows is a Node.js version manager for Windows, recommended by Microsoft, npm, and Google. It allows users to easily install, switch, and manage multiple Node.js versions. It is distinct from the Mac/Linux nvm, with a different philosophy tailored for Windows.
en.content: The repository includes full Go source code, installer executables, a command-line tool, and extensive documentation and Wiki. It offers a stable v1.1.12 release and a transitional v1.2.x, with a successor called Runtime in development.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging Windows APIs for system integration and managing versions via the npm and Node.js ecosystem.
en.hot: As the most popular Node.js version manager on Windows, it has over 47k stars, with 102 added this week, maintaining developer trust. Its recommended status and active development (e.g., Runtime) keep it trending.
uses: Windows developers managing multiple Node.js projects needing quick version switching
Frontend or full-stack engineers on Windows ensuring consistent local development environments
DevOps or CI/CD pipelines managing Node.js versions on Windows build servers

zh.tag: 为 Ansible、Terraform 等 DevOps 工具提供现代 UI 和 API
zh.what: Semaphore UI 是一个现代化的 Web 界面，用于管理 Ansible、Terraform/OpenTofu/Terragrunt、PowerShell 等 DevOps 工具。它允许用户轻松运行 playbook、脚本，接收失败任务通知，并控制部署系统的访问权限。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 UI 代码、API 服务、Docker 镜像、安装脚本以及文档。核心概念包括项目、任务模板、任务、计划、库存和变量组。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能涉及 JavaScript/TypeScript 框架。依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，支持多种安装方式。
zh.hot: 随着 DevOps 实践普及，对可视化工具需求增加。Semaphore UI 提供现代化界面和强大 API，在 GitHub 上获得 14k+ stars，今日新增 4 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 19 名。
uses: DevOps 工程师：通过 Web UI 管理 Ansible/Terraform 任务，替代命令行操作
团队协作：集中管理部署任务，控制访问权限，提升协作效率
自动化运维：利用计划功能定时执行任务，实现自动化部署

en.tag: Modern UI and powerful API for Ansible, Terraform and other DevOps tools
en.what: Semaphore UI is a modern web interface for managing popular DevOps tools like Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu/Terragrunt, PowerShell, and others. It lets you easily run playbooks and scripts, receive notifications about failed tasks, and control access to your deployment system.
en.content: The repository contains the full UI code, API service, Docker images, installation scripts, and documentation. Key concepts include projects, task templates, tasks, schedules, inventory, and variable groups.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with frontend likely using JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks. Relies on Docker for containerized deployment and supports multiple installation methods.
en.hot: As DevOps practices become widespread, the demand for visualization tools grows. Semaphore UI offers a modern interface and powerful API, earning 14k+ stars on GitHub, with 4 new stars today, ranking 19th on the Go trending list.
uses: DevOps engineers: manage Ansible/Terraform tasks via web UI instead of CLI
Team collaboration: centrally manage deployment tasks with access control for efficiency
Automated operations: use schedules to run tasks automatically at set times

zh.tag: 容器生态的乐高积木，Docker 开源上游
zh.what: Moby 是 Docker 创建的开源项目，提供模块化组件和框架，用于组装自定义的容器系统。它包含构建工具、注册表、编排工具和运行时等，旨在加速软件容器化。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心组件如 containerd、runc、buildkit 等，以及文档、API 定义和示例。以 Go 编写，提供可互换的模块化架构。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Linux 内核特性（cgroups、namespaces），并集成 containerd、runc 等底层组件。
zh.hot: 作为 Docker 的上游项目，Moby 拥有 7 万+ star，是容器技术的基石，持续吸引开发者关注和贡献。
uses: 容器引擎开发者：深入理解 Docker 内部机制，参与核心代码贡献
系统集成商：基于 Moby 组件构建定制化容器平台
DevOps 工程师：学习容器化最佳实践，优化部署流程
技术爱好者：研究容器运行时和镜像构建原理

en.tag: Lego set for container systems, Docker's open upstream
en.what: Moby is an open-source project by Docker that provides modular components and a framework for assembling custom container-based systems. It includes build tools, a registry, orchestration tools, and a runtime, aiming to accelerate software containerization.
en.content: The repo contains core components like containerd, runc, buildkit, along with docs, API definitions, and examples. Written in Go, it offers a modular architecture with swappable components.
en.stack: Primarily Go, leveraging Linux kernel features (cgroups, namespaces), and integrating low-level components like containerd and runc.
en.hot: As Docker's upstream, Moby has 70k+ stars, serving as a cornerstone of container tech, continuously attracting developer attention and contributions.
uses: Container engine developers: dive into Docker internals and contribute core code
System integrators: build custom container platforms using Moby components
DevOps engineers: learn containerization best practices and optimize deployments
Tech enthusiasts: study container runtime and image building principles

zh.tag: CUDA 核心计算库，统一 Thrust、CUB 与 libcudacxx
zh.what: CCCL 是 NVIDIA 将三个关键的 CUDA C++ 库（Thrust、CUB、libcudacxx）合并到一个仓库中的项目，旨在为 CUDA 开发者提供构建高效、安全代码的基础模块。它简化了开发流程，并增强了利用 CUDA C++ 的能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Thrust（并行算法库）、CUB（底层 CUDA 专用库，提供设备级和协作算法）以及 libcudacxx（CUDA C++ 标准库实现），并包含文档、示例和开发容器配置。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 C++，依赖 CUDA 工具包，支持多种后端（如 TBB、OpenMP）以实现性能可移植性。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增 star 不多，但作为 NVIDIA 官方统一库，合并了三个广泛使用的项目，对 CUDA 开发者极具吸引力，长期热度稳定。
uses: CUDA C++ 开发者：使用 Thrust 进行高层并行算法开发，提高生产力。
高性能计算研究人员：利用 CUB 的底层原语优化自定义内核。
需要跨平台性能可移植性的团队：通过配置后端在 GPU 和 CPU 上运行。
希望使用标准库特性的开发者：libcudacxx 提供 host/device 兼容的 C++ 标准库。

en.tag: Unified CUDA C++ core libraries: Thrust, CUB, and libcudacxx
en.what: CCCL is NVIDIA's project that unifies three essential CUDA C++ libraries (Thrust, CUB, libcudacxx) into a single repository, providing building blocks for CUDA developers to write safe and efficient code. It streamlines development and broadens the ability to leverage CUDA C++.
en.content: The repository contains Thrust (parallel algorithms), CUB (low-level CUDA-specific library with device-wide and cooperative algorithms), and libcudacxx (CUDA C++ standard library implementation), along with documentation, examples, and dev container configurations.
en.stack: Primarily C++, depends on the CUDA toolkit, supports multiple backends (e.g., TBB, OpenMP) for performance portability.
en.hot: Despite modest daily stars, as NVIDIA's official unified library merging three widely-used projects, it holds strong appeal for CUDA developers, maintaining steady long-term popularity.
uses: CUDA C++ developers: use Thrust for high-level parallel algorithms to boost productivity.
HPC researchers: leverage CUB's low-level primitives to optimize custom kernels.
Teams needing performance portability: configure backends to run on GPUs and CPUs.
Developers wanting standard library features: libcudacxx provides host/device-compatible C++ standard library.

zh.tag: 单文件分发与运行大模型的跨平台工具
zh.what: llamafile 将 llama.cpp 与 Cosmopolitan Libc 结合，把大语言模型打包成单个可执行文件，无需安装即可在多数操作系统和 CPU 架构上本地运行。它还包含 whisperfile，一个基于 whisper.cpp 的单文件语音转文字工具，支持音频转录和翻译。目标是让开源 LLM 对开发者和终端用户更易用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 llamafile 的源代码、构建系统（v0.10.* 起新构建系统）、文档、示例和预构建的 llamafile 发布版本。还包含基于 whisper.cpp 的 whisperfile 工具，以及用于对齐 llama.cpp 最新版本的更新机制。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 C++，依赖 llama.cpp、whisper.cpp 和 Cosmopolitan Libc。支持多种 CPU 架构和操作系统，无需安装依赖。
zh.hot: 以 25.6k stars 位居 C++ 趋势榜第二，因其极简的“单文件运行 LLM”理念大幅降低了本地部署门槛，受到开发者青睐。
uses: 希望快速在本地运行 LLM 的开发者，无需复杂环境配置
需要跨平台分发 AI 应用或模型的团队，简化交付流程
对隐私敏感、要求数据本地处理的终端用户
语音转录与翻译场景，利用 whisperfile 单文件工具

en.tag: Distribute and run LLMs as a single cross-platform executable
en.what: llamafile combines llama.cpp with Cosmopolitan Libc to package LLMs into a single executable that runs locally on most OSes and CPU architectures without installation. It also includes whisperfile, a single-file speech-to-text tool built on whisper.cpp, supporting transcription and translation. The goal is to make open LLMs more accessible to developers and end users.
en.content: The repo contains the llamafile source code, build system (new since v0.10.*), docs, examples, and pre-built llamafile releases. It also includes the whisperfile tool based on whisper.cpp, and mechanisms to stay aligned with latest llama.cpp.
en.stack: Primarily C++, built on llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, and Cosmopolitan Libc. Supports multiple CPU architectures and OSes with no installation dependencies.
en.hot: With 25.6k stars and #2 on C++ trending, its minimalist 'single-file LLM' approach drastically lowers the barrier to local deployment, gaining strong developer traction.
uses: Developers wanting to run LLMs locally without complex setup
Teams distributing AI apps/models cross-platform with simplified delivery
Privacy-conscious end users requiring local data processing
Speech transcription and translation scenarios using whisperfile

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.
uses: ML researchers —— who need flexible low-level APIs for model innovation and algorithmic experiments
AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: 从零重写的《上古卷轴：竞技场》开源引擎
zh.what: OpenTESArena 是一个从零开始重写的现代开源引擎，用于运行 1994 年的 DOS 游戏《上古卷轴：竞技场》。它采用洁净室方法，旨在复刻原版游戏的所有方面，同时进行生活质量改进。目前，游戏已实现敌人战斗、物品拾取/装备/丢弃、商店交易、NPC 互动、快速旅行和角色创建等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的引擎源代码、构建配置（CMake）、文档（wiki）和预览截图。不包含任何游戏资源，玩家需自行提供原版游戏文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并利用 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 该项目以 1383 颗星登上 GitHub 趋势榜（C++ 日榜第 4），因为它是经典游戏《上古卷轴：竞技场》的现代重制引擎，吸引了大量怀旧玩家和开源爱好者。
uses: 怀旧玩家：希望以现代方式重温《上古卷轴：竞技场》的玩家。
游戏开发者：对游戏引擎开发、逆向工程或洁净室实现感兴趣的开发者。
开源贡献者：希望参与经典游戏重制项目的贡献者。

en.tag: Open-source engine re-implementing The Elder Scrolls: Arena from scratch
en.what: OpenTESArena is a modern open-source engine written from scratch for the 1994 DOS game The Elder Scrolls: Arena. It uses a clean-room approach to replicate all aspects of the original game while making quality-of-life changes. Currently, it features enemy combat, item pickup/equip/drop, shopkeeper services, NPC interactions, fast travel, and character creation.
en.content: The repository contains the full engine source code, build configuration (CMake), documentation (wiki), and preview screenshots. No game assets are included; players must provide the original game files.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, uses CMake for building, and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With 1383 stars, it ranks #4 on GitHub Trending for C++ today, attracting retro gamers and open-source enthusiasts due to its modern re-implementation of the classic game.
uses: Retro gamers: those who want to revisit The Elder Scrolls: Arena with modern enhancements.
Game developers: interested in engine development, reverse engineering, or clean-room implementations.
Open-source contributors: looking to contribute to a classic game re-implementation project.

zh.tag: 开源 RTL 综合框架，Verilog/SystemVerilog 到网表
zh.what: Yosys 是一个用于 RTL 综合的开源框架，支持 Verilog-2005 和 SystemVerilog 的可综合子集。它通过合成脚本组合现有算法，可适应各种综合任务，并支持形式化验证前端 SBY。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Yosys 的 C++ 源码、综合算法库（如 abc）、SystemVerilog 解析器集成（sv-elab 和 slang），以及文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 abc 和 slang 等库，支持通过 OSS CAD Suite 或 Tabby CAD Suite 分发。
zh.hot: Yosys 是开源硬件设计的关键工具，star 数 4674 且持续增长，今日新增 4 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第五，反映了其在芯片设计社区中的广泛使用。
uses: 数字芯片设计者：用于 RTL 综合和网表生成
FPGA 开发者：配合开源工具链进行逻辑综合
形式化验证工程师：使用 SBY 进行验证
教育研究者：学习综合算法和硬件设计

en.tag: Open-source RTL synthesis framework, Verilog/SystemVerilog to netlist
en.what: Yosys is an open-source framework for RTL synthesis, supporting Verilog-2005 and a synthesizable subset of SystemVerilog. It adapts to various synthesis tasks by combining existing passes via synthesis scripts, and supports formal verification via SBY.
en.content: The repository contains Yosys C++ source code, synthesis algorithms (e.g., abc), SystemVerilog parser integrations (sv-elab and slang), plus documentation and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on abc and slang libraries, distributed via OSS CAD Suite or Tabby CAD Suite.
en.hot: Yosys is a critical tool for open-source hardware design, with 4674 stars and steady growth (4 today), ranking 5th on the C++ trending list, reflecting its widespread adoption in the chip design community.
uses: Digital chip designers: for RTL synthesis and netlist generation
FPGA developers: for logic synthesis with open-source toolchains
Formal verification engineers: using SBY for verification
Educators and researchers: to study synthesis algorithms and hardware design

zh.tag: 极速 C++ 日志库，头文件或编译版可选
zh.what: spdlog 是一个极速的 C++ 日志库，支持头文件模式和编译模式，提供丰富的格式化、异步日志、多线程/单线程日志器，以及多种日志输出目标（如控制台、文件、syslog 等）。它基于 fmt 库实现高性能格式化，并支持运行时和编译时日志级别过滤。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件（include/spdlog）、示例（example）、测试（tests）和 CMake 构建配置。提供多种 sink 实现（如旋转文件、每日文件、控制台、syslog 等），并支持自定义格式化。
zh.stack: C++11 及以上，依赖 fmt 库（可选，也可使用内置 fmt）。支持 CMake 构建，并可通过包管理器（如 apt、brew、vcpkg）安装。
zh.hot: spdlog 是 C++ 社区最受欢迎的日志库之一，拥有近 3 万 star，因其极高性能、易用性和丰富的功能而广受好评。今日新增 3 个 star，仍保持 C++ 日榜第 6 名，持续活跃。
uses: C++ 开发者：需要高性能日志记录，用于调试和监控应用程序。
嵌入式/系统编程：支持多平台（Linux、Windows、macOS、Android），适合资源受限环境。
游戏开发：需要低延迟日志输出，异步模式可减少性能影响。
库作者：作为内部日志工具，提供简单 API 和可扩展性。

en.tag: Fast C++ logging library with header-only or compiled options
en.what: spdlog is a fast C++ logging library that supports header-only and compiled modes, offering rich formatting, asynchronous logging, multi/single-threaded loggers, and various log sinks (console, files, syslog, etc.). It leverages the fmt library for high-performance formatting and supports runtime and compile-time log level filtering.
en.content: The repository contains headers (include/spdlog), examples (example), tests, and CMake build configuration. It provides various sink implementations (rotating files, daily files, console, syslog, etc.) and supports custom formatting.
en.stack: C++11 or later, depends on fmt library (optional, can use bundled fmt). Built with CMake, installable via package managers (apt, brew, vcpkg, etc.).
en.hot: spdlog is one of the most popular C++ logging libraries with nearly 30k stars, praised for its high performance, ease of use, and rich features. It gained 3 stars today, maintaining 6th place on the C++ daily trending list, showing continued activity.
uses: C++ developers needing high-performance logging for debugging and monitoring applications.
Embedded/system programmers: supports multiple platforms (Linux, Windows, macOS, Android), suitable for resource-constrained environments.
Game developers: low-latency logging with async mode to minimize performance impact.
Library authors: as an internal logging utility with simple API and extensibility.

zh.tag: 统一分布式存储平台，支持对象、块与文件
zh.what: Ceph 是一个开源的分布式存储系统，提供对象存储、块存储和文件系统三种接口。它设计为可扩展、高可用，并能在普通硬件上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ceph 的完整源代码，包括核心守护进程（如 MON、OSD、MDS）、管理工具、客户端库和测试套件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Boost、gRPC、RocksDB 等库，使用 CMake 和 Ninja 构建。
zh.hot: 作为成熟的分布式存储解决方案，Ceph 在云基础设施中广泛使用，其稳定性和功能丰富性使其持续受到关注。
uses: 云平台和虚拟化环境中的统一存储后端
大数据分析和归档场景的对象存储
需要高可用块存储的数据库或虚拟机
研究和学习分布式系统设计的开发者

en.tag: Unified distributed storage platform for object, block, and file
en.what: Ceph is an open-source distributed storage system that provides object, block, and file storage interfaces. It is designed to be scalable, highly available, and run on commodity hardware.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Ceph, including core daemons (MON, OSD, MDS), management tools, client libraries, and test suites.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with dependencies on Boost, gRPC, RocksDB, etc., and built using CMake and Ninja.
en.hot: As a mature distributed storage solution, Ceph is widely used in cloud infrastructure, and its stability and feature richness keep it in the spotlight.
uses: Unified storage backend for cloud platforms and virtualization environments
Object storage for big data analytics and archival
High-availability block storage for databases or VMs
Developers researching distributed system design

zh.tag: ROCm 系统组件统一仓库，简化开发与 CI
zh.what: 这是一个将多个 ROCm 系统项目整合到单一仓库的超级仓库，旨在简化开发、持续集成和集成流程。首批项目聚焦于构建 PyTorch 所需的基础组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个已迁移完成的组件，如 amdsmi、aqlprofile、clr、hip、hip-tests、rdc、rocdbgapi、rocdecode、rocjpeg、rocm-core、rocminfo、rocm-smi-lib、rocprofiler 等，并提供了各组件迁移状态和 CI 健康度的表格。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，并依赖 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成，涉及 ROCm 生态的多个底层库和工具。
zh.hot: 作为 ROCm 官方超级仓库，它集中管理多个关键组件，对 AMD GPU 开发者和 PyTorch 用户至关重要，尽管 star 数不高，但在 C++ 日榜上排名第八，体现了其在 ROCm 生态中的核心地位。
uses: AMD GPU 开发者：需要构建或调试 ROCm 底层组件的开发者。
PyTorch 贡献者：需要了解或使用 ROCm 构建 PyTorch 所需依赖的开发者。
系统集成工程师：需要统一管理多个 ROCm 系统项目 CI 和发布的团队。

en.tag: Unified super-repo for ROCm systems projects, streamlining dev & CI
en.what: This is a super-repo consolidating multiple ROCm systems projects into one repository to streamline development, CI, and integration. The initial set of projects focuses on requirements for building PyTorch.
en.content: The repo contains multiple migrated components such as amdsmi, aqlprofile, clr, hip, hip-tests, rdc, rocdbgapi, rocdecode, rocjpeg, rocm-core, rocminfo, rocm-smi-lib, rocprofiler, etc., along with a table showing migration status and CI health for each.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with GitHub Actions for CI, involving multiple low-level libraries and tools from the ROCm ecosystem.
en.hot: As the official ROCm super-repo, it centralizes management of key components, crucial for AMD GPU developers and PyTorch users. Despite modest stars, it ranks 8th on the C++ daily trending, reflecting its core role in the ROCm ecosystem.
uses: AMD GPU developers: those building or debugging low-level ROCm components.
PyTorch contributors: developers needing to understand or use ROCm dependencies for PyTorch builds.
System integration engineers: teams needing unified management of CI and releases across multiple ROCm system projects.

zh.tag: 云原生高性能边缘/中间/服务代理
zh.what: Envoy 是一个为云原生应用设计的高性能代理，用于处理边缘、中间和服务间的通信。它提供了丰富的流量管理、可观测性和安全特性，是服务网格（如 Istio）的核心数据平面。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Envoy 的完整源代码、API 定义、文档和示例。主要目录包括 source（核心实现）、api（数据平面 API）、test（测试）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Bazel 构建系统，并集成多种第三方库（如 gRPC、Protobuf）。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，Envoy 是服务网格生态的基石，被 Istio、AWS App Mesh 等广泛采用。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但其长期稳定增长和行业影响力使其持续热门。
uses: 服务网格数据平面：作为 Istio 等服务网格的 sidecar 代理，处理微服务间流量。
边缘代理：作为 API 网关或边缘入口，提供负载均衡、TLS 终止和路由。
基础设施团队：需要构建高性能、可观测的代理或网关的开发者。
云原生应用开发者：希望深入理解服务网格和代理技术的工程师。

en.tag: Cloud-native high-performance edge/middle/service proxy
en.what: Envoy is a high-performance proxy designed for cloud-native applications, handling edge, middle, and service-to-service communication. It offers advanced traffic management, observability, and security features, serving as the core data plane for service meshes like Istio.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, API definitions, documentation, and examples for Envoy. Key directories include source (core implementation), api (data plane API), test (tests), etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with Bazel, and integrates various third-party libraries (e.g., gRPC, Protobuf).
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, Envoy is a cornerstone of the service mesh ecosystem, widely adopted by Istio, AWS App Mesh, and others. Despite modest daily star growth, its long-term steady increase and industry influence keep it trending.
uses: Service mesh data plane: acts as a sidecar proxy in service meshes like Istio to handle inter-service traffic.
Edge proxy: serves as an API gateway or edge ingress, providing load balancing, TLS termination, and routing.
Infrastructure teams: developers building high-performance, observable proxies or gateways.
Cloud-native developers: engineers seeking deep understanding of service mesh and proxy technologies.

zh.tag: 高性能分布式梯度提升库，机器学习竞赛利器
zh.what: XGBoost 是一个优化的分布式梯度提升库，旨在高效、灵活且可移植。它实现了梯度提升框架下的机器学习算法，提供并行树提升（GBDT、GBM），能够快速准确地解决许多数据科学问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心实现，以及 Python、R、Java、Scala 等语言的接口封装，还有示例、文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多语言接口，可运行于单机、Hadoop、Spark、Dask、Flink 和 DataFlow 等分布式环境。
zh.hot: 作为机器学习领域的经典工具，XGBoost 拥有 28.6k 星标，因其在竞赛和工业界的卓越表现而广受欢迎，今日新增 5 星，仍位居 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: 数据科学家和机器学习工程师：用于分类、回归、排序等任务，尤其在 Kaggle 等竞赛中表现优异。
需要处理大规模数据的企业：支持分布式训练，可处理数十亿样本。
学术研究者：作为基准模型或研究梯度提升算法。

en.tag: High-performance distributed gradient boosting library, a machine learning competition powerhouse
en.what: XGBoost is an optimized distributed gradient boosting library designed to be highly efficient, flexible, and portable. It implements machine learning algorithms under the Gradient Boosting framework, providing parallel tree boosting (GBDT, GBM) that solves many data science problems in a fast and accurate way.
en.content: The repository contains the C++ core implementation, language bindings for Python, R, Java, Scala, etc., along with examples, documentation, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with multi-language bindings, and runs on single machine, Hadoop, Spark, Dask, Flink, and DataFlow.
en.hot: As a classic tool in machine learning, XGBoost has 28.6k stars, popular for its outstanding performance in competitions and industry. With 5 stars added today, it remains on the C++ trending list.
uses: Data scientists and ML engineers: for classification, regression, ranking, etc., especially in competitions like Kaggle.
Enterprises dealing with large-scale data: supports distributed training for billions of examples.
Academic researchers: as a baseline model or for studying gradient boosting algorithms.

zh.tag: 自动四边形网格重构工具，将高模转为干净四边形拓扑
zh.what: AutoRemesher 是一个跨平台的自动四边形网格重构工具，能将高多边形网格转换为干净的四边形拓扑结构。它基于 Geogram、libigl 等库构建，提供 GUI 和 CLI 两种模式。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本（支持 Linux/Windows/macOS）、第三方依赖（如 TBB）以及示例模型。用户可通过 qmake 或 CMake 构建，并附带截图和捐赠链接。
zh.stack: 基于 C++14，依赖 Qt 5.15.2、TBB、Geogram、libigl 等库，使用 qmake 构建，Windows 下需 CMake 编译 TBB。
zh.hot: 今日新增 40 星，总星数 3207，位列 GitHub 趋势榜 C++ 第 11 名。作为一款实用的自动四边形重构工具，受到 3D 建模和游戏开发者的关注。
uses: 3D 建模师：快速将高模转换为低面数四边形模型，用于动画和游戏
游戏开发者：优化角色和场景资产的拓扑结构，提升渲染性能
研究人员：在网格处理、几何算法领域进行实验和教学

en.tag: Automatic quad remeshing tool converting high-poly meshes to clean quad topology
en.what: AutoRemesher is a cross-platform automatic quad remeshing tool that converts high-polygon meshes into clean quad-based topology. Built on Geogram, libigl, and other libraries, it offers both GUI and CLI modes.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build scripts for Linux/Windows/macOS, third-party dependencies (e.g., TBB), and example models. Users can build via qmake or CMake, with screenshots and a donation link included.
en.stack: Built with C++14, depends on Qt 5.15.2, TBB, Geogram, libigl, and others; uses qmake for building, with CMake needed on Windows to compile TBB.
en.hot: Gained 40 stars today, total 3207, ranking 11th on GitHub Trending for C++. As a practical automatic quad remeshing tool, it attracts attention from 3D modelers and game developers.
uses: 3D modelers: quickly convert high-poly models to low-poly quad meshes for animation and games
Game developers: optimize topology of character and scene assets for better rendering performance
Researchers: experiment and teach in mesh processing and geometric algorithms

zh.tag: 面向 AI 训练/推理的高性能分布式文件系统
zh.what: 3FS 是 DeepSeek 开源的分布式文件系统，专为 AI 训练和推理负载设计。它利用现代 SSD 和 RDMA 网络提供共享存储层，简化分布式应用的开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含设计文档、部署指南、USRBIO API 参考、性能基准（如 fio 引擎）以及核心 C++ 源码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，依赖 RDMA 网络和 NVMe SSD，采用 FoundationDB 作为事务性键值存储，支持 CRAQ 强一致性。
zh.hot: 作为 DeepSeek 开源项目，3FS 在 GitHub 上迅速获得 1 万+ star，因其解决 AI 训练存储瓶颈而备受关注。
uses: AI 训练和推理平台：需要高性能共享存储来支撑大规模模型训练和推理。
数据预处理管道：高效管理中间输出和分层目录结构。
大规模分布式应用：需要强一致性和高吞吐文件访问的场景。

en.tag: High-performance distributed file system for AI training & inference
en.what: 3FS is an open-source distributed file system by DeepSeek, designed for AI training and inference workloads. It leverages modern SSDs and RDMA networks to provide a shared storage layer that simplifies distributed application development.
en.content: The repository includes design notes, setup guide, USRBIO API reference, performance benchmarks (e.g., fio engine), and core C++ source code.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, relies on RDMA networks and NVMe SSDs, uses FoundationDB as transactional key-value store, and implements CRAQ for strong consistency.
en.hot: As a DeepSeek open-source project, 3FS quickly gained 10k+ stars on GitHub, drawing attention for addressing AI training storage bottlenecks.
uses: AI training and inference platforms: need high-performance shared storage for large-scale model training and inference.
Data preparation pipelines: efficiently manage intermediate outputs and hierarchical directory structures.
Large-scale distributed applications: require strong consistency and high-throughput file access.

zh.tag: 为逆向工程师与程序员打造的现代化十六进制编辑器
zh.what: ImHex 是一款功能强大的十六进制编辑器，专为逆向工程、编程和数据分析设计。它提供了直观的界面和丰富的工具，帮助用户深入检查和编辑二进制文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、构建脚本、插件支持以及预编译的发布版本。项目结构清晰，包含核心编辑器、图形界面、模式语言（Pattern Language）和多种辅助工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Capstone、Zydis 等反汇编库，以及 Dear ImGui 等图形界面库。支持跨平台构建，包括 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 凭借其强大的功能和活跃的社区，ImHex 已获得超过 5.4 万颗星。今日新增 9 颗星，持续受到开发者青睐，尤其在逆向工程领域备受推崇。
uses: 逆向工程师：分析恶意软件、固件和二进制漏洞
程序员：调试和检查二进制文件、数据结构
安全研究人员：进行漏洞研究和取证分析
学生与爱好者：学习二进制格式和底层原理

en.tag: A modern hex editor for reverse engineers and programmers
en.what: ImHex is a powerful hex editor designed for reverse engineering, programming, and data analysis. It offers an intuitive interface and rich tools to help users inspect and edit binary files in depth.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, build scripts, plugin support, and precompiled releases. The project is well-structured, including the core editor, GUI, pattern language, and various auxiliary tools.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, it depends on disassembly libraries like Capstone and Zydis, and GUI libraries like Dear ImGui. It supports cross-platform builds for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With its powerful features and active community, ImHex has gained over 54k stars. It continues to be favored by developers, especially in reverse engineering, with 9 new stars today.
uses: Reverse engineers: analyze malware, firmware, and binary vulnerabilities
Programmers: debug and inspect binary files and data structures
Security researchers: conduct vulnerability research and forensic analysis
Students and enthusiasts: learn binary formats and low-level principles

zh.tag: 生产级系统追踪与性能分析套件
zh.what: Perfetto 是一套开源的生产级追踪与分析工具，用于捕获和可视化复杂系统的行为，帮助开发者定位功能与性能问题。它是 Android 和 Chromium 的默认追踪系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含高性能追踪守护进程、低开销 C++17 追踪 SDK、丰富的 OS 级探针（如调度、CPU 频率、内存剖析）、基于浏览器的可视化 UI，以及基于 SQL 的分析库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 SQLite 等，支持 Android、Linux、macOS、Windows 等平台。
zh.hot: 作为 Android 和 Chromium 的默认追踪系统，Perfetto 拥有庞大的用户基础，其生产级特性和强大的分析能力使其在开发者中持续热门。
uses: Android 应用与平台开发者：调试启动慢、掉帧、ANR 等性能问题
C/C++ 开发者：使用追踪 SDK 自定义插桩，分析执行流程与瓶颈
Linux 内核与系统开发者：深入分析调度、系统调用、中断等内核行为
性能工程师与 SRE：通过 SQL 接口分析多种追踪格式，自动化提取指标

en.tag: Production-grade system tracing, profiling, and trace analysis suite
en.what: Perfetto is an open-source, production-grade tracing and analysis suite for capturing and visualizing the behavior of complex systems, helping developers root-cause functional and performance issues. It is the default tracing system for Android and Chromium.
en.content: The repo contains high-performance tracing daemons, a low-overhead C++17 tracing SDK, extensive OS-level probes (e.g., scheduling, CPU frequency, memory profiling), a browser-based UI for visualization, and a SQL-based analysis library.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies like SQLite; supports Android, Linux, macOS, Windows, etc.
en.hot: As the default tracing system for Android and Chromium, Perfetto has a massive user base; its production-grade features and powerful analysis capabilities keep it trending among developers.
uses: Android app & platform developers: debug slow startups, jank, ANRs, etc.
C/C++ developers: instrument custom trace points to analyze execution flow and bottlenecks
Linux kernel & system developers: deep insights into scheduling, syscalls, interrupts
Performance engineers & SREs: analyze multiple trace formats via SQL, automate metric extraction

zh.tag: 用手机指纹/人脸解锁电脑的桌面客户端
zh.what: PC Bio Unlock 的桌面端应用，让你在登录界面、锁屏或权限提示时，用 Android 手机的指纹或人脸确认代替输入密码。它通过局域网或蓝牙与手机通信，无需联网或账号，自动发现电脑，扫码或输入配对码即可配对。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面客户端源码，支持 Windows、Linux（x64/ARM）和 macOS（实验性），涵盖登录/锁屏、UAC、sudo/polkit 等场景。安装包在 Releases 页面提供。
zh.stack: 主要用 C++ 编写，依赖平台相关 API 实现系统集成，使用加密通信确保安全。
zh.hot: 虽然 star 数不高（377），但今日新增 10 星并登上 C++ 日榜，因其解决真实痛点：免密解锁电脑，且注重安全隐私，密码永不出机。
uses: 想摆脱频繁输入密码的 Windows/Linux 用户
追求便捷与安全兼顾的 Android 手机用户
对生物识别解锁电脑感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: Desktop client to unlock your PC with phone fingerprint/face
en.what: Desktop app for PC Bio Unlock, letting you confirm with your Android phone's fingerprint or face instead of typing your password at login, lock screen, or permission prompts. It communicates over Wi-Fi/LAN or Bluetooth, no account or internet required, auto-discovers your PC, and pairs via QR code or pairing code.
en.content: The repo contains the desktop client source code, supporting Windows, Linux (x64/ARM), and macOS (experimental), covering login/lock screen, UAC, sudo/polkit prompts. Installers are on the Releases page.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, leveraging platform-specific APIs for system integration, with encrypted communication for security.
en.hot: Despite modest stars (377), it gained 10 today and hit the C++ daily trending, because it solves a real pain point: passwordless PC unlock with strong security/privacy—your password never leaves your PC.
uses: Windows/Linux users tired of typing passwords frequently
Android users who value both convenience and security
Tech enthusiasts interested in biometric PC unlocking

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 原生测试框架，支持单元测试、TDD 和 BDD
zh.what: Catch2 是一个用于 C++ 的单元测试框架，同时提供微基准测试和简单的 BDD 宏。它的主要优势是使用简单自然，测试名称不必是有效标识符，断言看起来像普通的 C++ 布尔表达式，并且 sections 提供了一种简洁的本地方式来共享测试中的设置和清理代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Catch2 的完整源代码、文档、示例以及用于构建和测试的 CMake 文件。v3 版本不再是单头文件库，而是作为普通库，包含多个头文件和单独编译的源文件。
zh.stack: C++ 编写，支持 C++14、C++17 及更高版本（v2.x 分支支持 C++11，Catch1.x 分支支持 C++03）。使用 CMake 构建，并集成 CI（GitHub Actions、AppVeyor）和代码覆盖率工具（Codecov）。
zh.hot: Catch2 是 C++ 社区中最受欢迎的测试框架之一，拥有超过 2.1 万 star。其简单自然的语法和强大的功能使其成为许多项目的首选，尽管今日新增 star 不多，但长期热度稳定。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试、TDD 或 BDD 风格测试
需要微基准测试功能的性能敏感项目
希望快速集成测试框架的 C++ 项目，尤其是使用 CMake 构建的项目

en.tag: A modern, C++-native test framework for unit tests, TDD, and BDD
en.what: Catch2 is a unit testing framework for C++, also providing basic micro-benchmarking features and simple BDD macros. Its main advantage is that using it is both simple and natural: test names don't have to be valid identifiers, assertions look like normal C++ boolean expressions, and sections provide a nice and local way to share set-up and tear-down code in tests.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and CMake files for building and testing. Version 3 is no longer a single-header library; it behaves as a normal library with multiple headers and separately compiled sources.
en.stack: Written in C++, supporting C++14, C++17 and later (C++11 support in v2.x branch, C++03 on Catch1.x). Built with CMake, with CI integration (GitHub Actions, AppVeyor) and code coverage (Codecov).
en.hot: Catch2 is one of the most popular test frameworks in the C++ community, with over 21k stars. Its simple and natural syntax and powerful features make it a top choice for many projects, and while today's star increase is modest, its long-term popularity remains steady.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests, TDD, or BDD-style tests
Performance-sensitive projects needing micro-benchmarking
C++ projects wanting a quick-to-integrate test framework, especially with CMake

zh.tag: C++ 函数式终端 UI 库
zh.what: FTXUI 是一个基于 C++ 的跨平台终端用户界面库，采用函数式编程风格，灵感来自 React。它提供了简洁优雅的语法，支持键盘和鼠标导航、UTF-8 和全角字符、动画以及绘图功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含库的源码、文档、示例和测试。目录结构包括 src、include、examples 和 documentation 等，提供了丰富的示例展示各种组件和功能。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，无外部依赖，支持 CMake 构建，跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）。
zh.hot: FTXUI 因其函数式 API 和丰富的功能而受到欢迎，star 数已超过 1 万，今日新增 6 个，在 C++ 日榜中排名第 17。
uses: 开发者构建终端应用或 TUI 工具时，需要现代且易用的 UI 库。
喜欢函数式编程风格，希望用类似 React 的组件模型开发终端界面。
需要跨平台支持，且希望避免依赖重量级 GUI 框架的场景。
学习 C++ 和终端 UI 设计，参考其示例和文档。

en.tag: C++ functional terminal UI library
en.what: FTXUI is a cross-platform C++ library for terminal-based user interfaces, using a functional style inspired by React. It offers simple and elegant syntax, supports keyboard and mouse navigation, UTF-8 and fullwidth characters, animations, and drawing.
en.content: The repository contains the library's source code, documentation, examples, and tests. The directory structure includes src, include, examples, and documentation, with extensive examples demonstrating various components and features.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with no external dependencies, built with CMake, cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows).
en.hot: FTXUI is popular for its functional API and rich features, with over 10k stars and 6 new stars today, ranking 17th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Developers building terminal apps or TUI tools needing a modern and easy-to-use UI library.
Those who prefer functional programming style and want a React-like component model for terminal interfaces.
Cross-platform needs without heavy GUI frameworks.
Learners of C++ and terminal UI design, referencing its examples and docs.

zh.tag: 以KVCache为中心的LLM服务分离式架构
zh.what: Mooncake是Moonshot AI为Kimi大模型服务打造的推理平台，采用以KVCache为中心的分离式架构，将预填充和解码阶段分离，并通过KVCache池化实现高效复用。该架构在真实负载下显著提升吞吐量和响应速度，降低推理成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心的Mooncake Transfer Engine（支持多种硬件如CUDA、NPU、MUSA），以及论文、幻灯片、测试轨迹和文档。提供Python包和Docker镜像，便于部署。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++实现高性能传输引擎，提供Python绑定（PyPI包），依赖CUDA等硬件加速，支持RDMA和EFA网络。
zh.hot: 作为Kimi背后的推理平台，Mooncake展示了真实生产环境的先进架构，吸引了大量关注。尽管今日新增star不多，但总star数已超6千，在C++日榜排名靠前，说明其技术影响力持续发酵。
uses: LLM推理服务提供商：希望借鉴生产级分离式架构来优化自身推理系统。
系统研究者：研究KVCache管理、预填充/解码分离等前沿技术。
高性能计算开发者：对RDMA、GPU传输优化感兴趣的工程师。
Moonshot AI生态用户：想了解Kimi底层技术或部署类似平台。

en.tag: KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture for LLM serving
en.what: Mooncake is the serving platform for Kimi, a leading LLM service by Moonshot AI. It uses a KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture that separates prefill and decode phases, pooling KVCache for efficient reuse. Under real workloads, it boosts throughput and reduces latency and cost.
en.content: The repo contains the core Mooncake Transfer Engine (supporting CUDA, NPU, MUSA, etc.), along with the paper, slides, traces, and documentation. It offers Python packages and Docker images for easy deployment.
en.stack: Primarily C++ for the high-performance transfer engine, with Python bindings (PyPI packages). It relies on CUDA and other hardware acceleration, supporting RDMA and EFA networks.
en.hot: As the serving platform behind Kimi, Mooncake showcases a production-grade advanced architecture, drawing significant attention. Despite modest daily stars, its total stars exceed 6k and it ranks high on the C++ daily list, indicating sustained technical influence.
uses: LLM serving providers: to adopt a production-grade disaggregated architecture for their inference systems.
Systems researchers: to study KVCache management and prefill/decode separation.
HPC developers: interested in RDMA and GPU transfer optimizations.
Moonshot AI ecosystem users: to understand Kimi's underlying tech or deploy similar platforms.

zh.tag: Jellyfin 官方桌面客户端，基于 Qt 与 MPV
zh.what: Jellyfin Desktop 是 Jellyfin 媒体服务器的桌面客户端，提供原生播放体验。它支持音频直通、硬件解码和更多格式的免转码播放。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端源代码、跨平台构建脚本（Windows/macOS/Linux）以及开发文档。配置和缓存按用户配置文件存储，支持通过 mpv.conf 自定义播放器。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 和 Qt WebEngine，集成 libmpv 播放器。依赖 Qt、libmpv 等。
zh.hot: 作为 Jellyfin 官方桌面客户端，持续维护并支持多平台，今日新增 7 星，总星数 5605，在 C++ 日榜中排名第 19。
uses: Jellyfin 用户希望获得原生桌面播放体验，支持音频直通和硬件解码。
开发者希望为 Jellyfin 桌面客户端贡献代码或自定义构建。
需要离线或高性能播放场景，如家庭影院 PC。

en.tag: Official Jellyfin desktop client built with Qt and MPV
en.what: Jellyfin Desktop is the desktop client for the Jellyfin media server, offering a native playback experience. It supports audio passthrough, hardware decoding, and playback of more formats without transcoding.
en.content: The repository contains the full client source code, cross-platform build scripts (Windows/macOS/Linux), and development docs. Configuration and cache are stored per-profile, with support for customizing the player via mpv.conf.
en.stack: Built with C++ and Qt WebEngine, integrating libmpv player. Dependencies include Qt, libmpv, etc.
en.hot: As the official Jellyfin desktop client, it is actively maintained and cross-platform, gaining 7 stars today and ranking #19 on the C++ daily trending list with 5605 total stars.
uses: Jellyfin users seeking a native desktop playback experience with audio passthrough and hardware decoding.
Developers who want to contribute to or customize the Jellyfin desktop client.

zh.tag: 给 AI 代理一个虚拟文件系统与执行环境
zh.what: Cloudflare Computer 是一个运行在 Durable Object 中的虚拟文件系统，为 AI 代理提供统一的文件操作和执行接口。它通过 workspace.runtime.exec 作为唯一入口，支持容器、隔离 shell 和隔离 JavaScript 三种后端，让代理能像操作真实电脑一样读写文件和运行程序。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心包 @cloudflare/computer、多个示例（容器、worker-shell、worker-javascript、egress）以及文档目录 docs/，展示了如何在不同后端上运行代理代码。
zh.stack: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 和 Durable Objects，使用 SQLite 存储状态，通过 capnweb RPC 通信；容器后端使用 FUSE 挂载，隔离 shell 使用 just-bash，隔离 JavaScript 使用 ECMAScript 模块。
zh.hot: 本周新增 6775 星，位居 Trending 榜首，因为它是 Cloudflare 官方推出的 AI 代理基础设施，提供新颖的虚拟文件系统概念，引发开发者广泛关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要为代理提供持久化文件系统和沙箱执行环境
实验与原型验证：探索代理与文件系统交互的新模式
Cloudflare 生态开发者：利用 Workers 和 Durable Objects 构建应用

en.tag: Give your agent a virtual filesystem and execution environment
en.what: Cloudflare Computer is a virtual filesystem living inside a Durable Object, providing AI agents with a unified file and execution interface. It exposes workspace.runtime.exec as the single entry point, supporting container, isolate shell, and isolate JavaScript backends, enabling agents to read/write files and run programs like on a real computer.
en.content: The repo includes the core package @cloudflare/computer, several examples (container, worker-shell, worker-javascript, egress), and a docs/ directory, demonstrating how to run agent code on different backends.
en.stack: Built on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects, with SQLite for state and capnweb RPC; container backend uses FUSE mounts, isolate shell uses just-bash, isolate JavaScript uses ECMAScript modules.
en.hot: Gained 6,775 stars this week, ranking #1 on Trending, because it's Cloudflare's official AI agent infrastructure with a novel virtual filesystem concept, attracting widespread developer attention.
uses: AI agent developers: need persistent filesystem and sandboxed execution for agents
Experimentation and prototyping: explore new patterns of agent-filesystem interaction
Cloudflare ecosystem developers: build apps on Workers and Durable Objects

en.tag: Google DeepMind's global medium-range weather & cyclone AI forecasting model
en.what: WeatherNext 2 is a global medium-range atmospheric and cyclone forecasting model developed by Google DeepMind and Google Research, offering deterministic predictions at 0.25° resolution (~30km). Data scientists: to access daily forecast data via APIs or cloud platforms for analysis
