寻求开源替代品来替代商业 AI 助手的人

en.tag: AI-powered personal OS for life and work
en.what: LifeOS is a general-purpose AI harness designed to help users move from their current state to an ideal state in both life and work. It captures who you are, what you care about, and where you're trying to go, then uses AI that knows you to help you get there, making everything you do more efficient and effective.
en.content: The repository contains the complete LifeOS system, including installation scripts, documentation, example configurations, integrations with AI agents like Claude, and core modules for managing personal knowledge bases and tasks.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, relies on the Bun runtime, and integrates with Claude AI and Pulse among other tools.
en.hot: LifeOS has quickly gained popularity on GitHub with over 17k stars, as it deeply integrates AI with personal productivity, meeting the demand for personalized AI assistants.
uses: Individuals looking to manage personal goals and projects with AI
Professionals needing AI-assisted knowledge management and task planning
Tech enthusiasts interested in AI agents and automation
People seeking open-source alternatives to commercial AI assistants

zh.tag: 多 AI 编程代理并行编排的桌面与移动工作平台
zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面端应用源码（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、移动端配套应用（iOS/Android），以及用于多代理并行执行、git worktree 管理与结果对比合并的核心模块。
zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript 构建，提供跨平台桌面客户端与移动端配套应用，通过集成多家第三方 AI 编程代理的 API 实现统一调度。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理百花齐放的背景下，Orca 以「并行工作树 + 移动端遥控」解决了多代理对比与随时监控的痛点；一周内新增 5,409 Star 并以 21.3k 总星数冲上 GitHub 周榜第 7，足见开发者对统一代理调度界面的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果
追求随时随地掌控编码任务的技术团队——通过移动端伴侣应用远程监控代理状态并追加指令
希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理
需要保持代码库隔离的谨慎工程师——每个代理在独立工作树中操作，避免污染主分支

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop application source (macOS/Windows/Linux), a mobile companion app (iOS and Android), and core modules for parallel agent execution, git worktree management, and result comparison/merging.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it provides cross-platform desktop clients and mobile companion apps, integrating third-party AI coding agent APIs for unified orchestration.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI Agent 工作台，GUI+TUI 一体化
zh.what: Kun 是一个本地优先的 AI Agent 工作台，将代码、写作、设计、研究和自动化整合到一个产品中。它通过共享运行时连接桌面 GUI 和终端 TUI，让任务从澄清到交付全程可控、可回溯。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面 GUI 和终端 TUI 的完整实现，支持多平台（macOS、Windows、Linux），内置多种工作模式（Direct、Agent Graph），并提供文档、示例和安装包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，依赖跨平台桌面框架和终端 UI 库，支持多种模型接入（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容、自托管等）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 413 星，总星数 6091，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 12 名。其本地优先、GUI+TUI 共享运行时的理念吸引开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：用于 AI 编程、代码审查和自动化任务，可在 GUI 或 TUI 中操作。
写作者：利用 AI 写作、润色和文档导出，支持 Markdown、PDF 等格式。
设计师：生成交互原型和设计系统，并与代码实现衔接。
研究人员：处理 PDF、图片等多模态资料，进行研究和分析。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace unifying GUI & TUI
en.what: Kun is a local-first AI agent workspace that unifies coding, writing, design, research, and automation in one product. It connects desktop GUI and terminal TUI via a shared runtime, making tasks visible, controllable, and traceable from clarification to delivery.
en.content: The repo contains full implementations of desktop GUI and terminal TUI, supporting multiple platforms (macOS, Windows, Linux), with built-in modes like Direct and Agent Graph, plus docs, examples, and installers.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, leveraging cross-platform desktop frameworks and terminal UI libraries, with support for multiple model providers (OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible, self-hosted, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 413 stars this week, reaching 6,091 total, ranking #12 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its local-first approach and unified GUI+TUI runtime resonate with developers.
uses: Developers: AI coding, code review, and automation, operable via GUI or TUI.
Writers: AI writing, polishing, and document export (Markdown, PDF, etc.).
Designers: Generate interactive prototypes and design systems, bridging to code.
Researchers: Process multimodal sources like PDFs and images for research.

zh.tag: 本地实时AI物体检测的NVR，深度集成Home Assistant
zh.what: Frigate是一个完整的本地NVR（网络视频录像机），专为Home Assistant设计，利用OpenCV和TensorFlow在本地对IP摄像头进行实时物体检测。它通过低开销的运动检测来触发目标检测，从而最小化资源占用并最大化性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含Frigate NVR的源代码、文档、Docker配置、UI（基于TypeScript）以及用于Home Assistant的自定义组件集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python（后端）和TypeScript（前端），依赖OpenCV、TensorFlow、MQTT、RTSP、WebRTC和MSE。支持GPU或AI加速器（如Coral TPU）以提升性能。
zh.hot: Frigate在GitHub上拥有35k+星标，本周新增207星，位居TypeScript周榜第11。它因与Home Assistant的无缝集成、本地隐私保护以及高效的实时物体检测而广受欢迎。
uses: Home Assistant用户：希望为智能家居添加本地AI监控和物体检测功能。
隐私敏感用户：希望避免将摄像头视频上传到云端，实现完全本地处理。
DIY爱好者：喜欢自建NVR，并利用GPU或AI加速器优化性能。

en.tag: Local NVR with realtime AI object detection, deeply integrated with Home Assistant
en.what: Frigate is a complete local NVR designed for Home Assistant, using OpenCV and TensorFlow for realtime object detection on IP cameras. It uses low-overhead motion detection to trigger object detection, minimizing resource usage and maximizing performance.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, Docker configuration, UI (TypeScript-based), and custom component integration for Home Assistant.
en.stack: Primarily Python (backend) and TypeScript (frontend), with dependencies on OpenCV, TensorFlow, MQTT, RTSP, WebRTC, and MSE. Supports GPU or AI accelerators (e.g., Coral TPU) for improved performance.
en.hot: Frigate has over 35k stars on GitHub, with 207 added this week, ranking 11th on the TypeScript weekly trending. It's popular for its seamless Home Assistant integration, local privacy, and efficient realtime object detection.
uses: Home Assistant users: want to add local AI monitoring and object detection to their smart home.
Privacy-conscious users: prefer fully local processing to avoid uploading camera footage to the cloud.
DIY enthusiasts: enjoy building their own NVR and optimizing performance with GPU or AI accelerators.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理提供统一集成层，安全连接各类应用
zh.what: Corsair 是一个为 AI 代理设计的统一集成层。它允许你连接自己的代理到 Corsair 实例，立即获得对所有集成的访问权限，同时代理永远看不到凭证，你可以精确控制它能做什么。它通过权限模式（如谨慎、严格）和审批流程，确保代理操作安全可控。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库（corsair/core）、各应用插件（如 GitHub、Slack、Gmail 等）、MCP 服务器、示例代码和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 MCP（模型上下文协议）与代理通信，支持多租户架构，依赖各应用 API。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2810 星，总星数近万，因其解决了 AI 代理安全集成应用的痛点，提供细粒度权限控制，符合当前 AI 代理工具链的热潮。
uses: 开发者：为自建 AI 代理添加安全的应用集成能力
企业：在多租户环境中管理代理对内部工具的访问
AI 应用开发者：通过 MCP 快速接入各类 SaaS 服务

en.tag: Unified integration layer for agents, safely connecting to any app
en.what: Corsair is a unified integration layer for AI agents. Connect your agent to a Corsair instance to instantly access all integrations, while the agent never sees credentials and you control exactly what it can do. It ensures safe operations through permission modes and approval flows.
en.content: The repo contains the core library (corsair/core), plugins for various apps (e.g., GitHub, Slack, Gmail), an MCP server, examples, and documentation.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses MCP (Model Context Protocol) for agent communication, supports multi-tenancy, and depends on various app APIs.
en.hot: Gained 2810 stars this week, nearing 10k total, because it addresses the pain point of safely integrating agents with apps, offering fine-grained permission control, riding the AI agent tooling wave.
uses: Developers: add secure app integrations to their own AI agents
Enterprises: manage agent access to internal tools in multi-tenant setups
AI app developers: quickly connect to SaaS services via MCP

zh.tag: FastAPI 全栈项目模板，前后端开箱即用
zh.what: 这是一个全栈 Web 应用模板，后端使用 FastAPI，前端使用 React，集成了 SQLModel、PostgreSQL、Vite、Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 等现代技术。它提供了完整的用户认证、仪表盘、API 文档和部署配置，适合快速启动新项目。
zh.content: 仓库包含后端（FastAPI、SQLModel、Pydantic）、前端（React、Vite、Tailwind、shadcn/ui）、Docker Compose 配置、Traefik 反向代理、GitHub Actions CI/CD 以及详细的文档。
zh.stack: 技术栈：Python FastAPI、SQLModel、Pydantic、PostgreSQL；前端 TypeScript、React、Vite、Tailwind CSS、shadcn/ui；部署用 Docker Compose、Traefik、FastAPI Cloud；测试用 Playwright 和 Pytest。
zh.hot: 作为 FastAPI 官方推荐的模板，它解决了全栈项目脚手架搭建的痛点，star 数已达 4.4 万，今日新增 51，持续受到开发者欢迎。
uses: 想快速启动 FastAPI + React 全栈项目的开发者
需要内置认证、仪表盘和部署配置的团队
学习现代全栈技术栈（FastAPI、React、Tailwind）的初学者
需要 Docker Compose 自托管部署的独立开发者

en.tag: Full-stack FastAPI template with React, PostgreSQL, and Docker Compose
en.what: A full-stack web application template with FastAPI backend and React frontend, integrating SQLModel, PostgreSQL, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui. It includes user authentication, dashboard, API docs, and deployment configs for rapid project startup.
en.content: The repo includes backend (FastAPI, SQLModel, Pydantic), frontend (React, Vite, Tailwind, shadcn/ui), Docker Compose setup, Traefik reverse proxy, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and comprehensive docs.
en.stack: Tech stack: Python FastAPI, SQLModel, Pydantic, PostgreSQL; frontend TypeScript, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui; deployment with Docker Compose, Traefik, FastAPI Cloud; testing with Playwright and Pytest.
en.hot: As an official FastAPI template, it solves the pain of scaffolding full-stack projects, with 44.8k stars and 51 new today, remaining popular among developers.
uses: Developers wanting to quickly bootstrap a FastAPI + React full-stack project
Teams needing built-in auth, dashboard, and deployment configs
Beginners learning modern full-stack stack (FastAPI, React, Tailwind)
Indie developers needing Docker Compose self-hosted deployment

zh.tag: 在浏览器里跑 VS Code，随时随地开发
zh.what: code-server 让你在任何设备的浏览器中运行 VS Code，提供一致的开发环境。它利用云端服务器加速测试、编译和下载，同时节省本地电量。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 code-server 源码、安装脚本、文档和截图，支持通过脚本、手动安装、云平台一键部署等多种方式启动。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，核心是 VS Code 的浏览器化封装，依赖 Node.js 和 WebSocket，可运行在 Linux 机器上（最低 1GB RAM、2 vCPU）。
zh.hot: 拥有近 7.9 万 star，本周新增 201，持续受到开发者欢迎，因为它解决了远程开发和环境一致性的痛点。
uses: 远程开发者：在云端服务器上编码，保持环境一致
移动办公族：用平板或低配电脑访问高性能开发环境
团队协作：通过 coder/coder 部署给团队使用
学习与实验：快速在浏览器中体验 VS Code 功能

en.tag: Run VS Code in the browser, develop anywhere
en.what: code-server lets you run VS Code in the browser on any device, providing a consistent development environment. It uses cloud servers to speed up tests, compilations, and downloads, while saving local battery life.
en.content: The repository contains the full code-server source code, install scripts, documentation, and screenshots, with multiple ways to get started including install script, manual install, and one-click cloud deployment.
en.stack: Developed in TypeScript, it's a browser-based wrapper around VS Code, relying on Node.js and WebSockets, and runs on Linux with at least 1GB RAM and 2 vCPUs.
en.hot: With nearly 79K stars and 201 added this week, it remains popular for solving remote development and environment consistency pain points.
uses: Remote developers: code on cloud servers with consistent environments
Mobile workers: access high-performance dev environments from tablets or low-spec laptops
Teams: deploy to your team via coder/coder
Learners: quickly experience VS Code features in the browser

zh.tag: 一站式网页数据提取 API，为 AI 代理提供干净数据
zh.what: Firecrawl 是一个开源 API，用于大规模搜索、抓取和与网页交互。它将网页内容转换为干净的 Markdown 或结构化数据，供 AI 代理使用，并处理代理轮换、速率限制等复杂问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 API 服务、SDK（Python/Node）、MCP 集成、自托管部署选项，以及搜索、抓取、爬取、映射等端点。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 Playwright 进行浏览器渲染，支持多种部署方式（Docker、云服务）。
zh.hot: 凭借 16.7 万星标和每周 4810 新增，Firecrawl 成为 AI 数据提取的首选工具，其可靠性和速度（P95 3.4 秒）备受青睐。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为 LLM 提供干净的网页上下文数据
数据科学家：大规模抓取网页数据用于分析和训练
企业用户：通过自托管实现数据提取的隐私和合规

en.tag: One-stop web data extraction API delivering clean data for AI agents
en.what: Firecrawl is an open-source API for searching, scraping, and interacting with the web at scale. It converts web content into clean Markdown or structured data for AI agents, handling complexities like proxy rotation and rate limits.
en.content: The repo includes the core API service, SDKs (Python/Node), MCP integration, self-hosting options, and endpoints for search, scrape, crawl, map, and more.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, uses Playwright for browser rendering, supports various deployment options (Docker, cloud).
en.hot: With 167k stars and 4,810 added this week, Firecrawl is the go-to tool for AI data extraction, praised for its reliability and speed (P95 3.4s).
uses: AI agent developers: provide clean web context data for LLMs
Data scientists: scrape web data at scale for analysis and training
Enterprise users: self-host for privacy and compliance in data extraction

zh.tag: 开源智能体操作系统，让 AI 代理自主运行
zh.what: elizaOS 是一个开源的 TypeScript 框架和产品栈，用于构建和运行自主 AI 代理。它提供核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务和原生桥接，支持从聊天、语音到设备控制等多种能力。
zh.content: 该仓库是一个 monorepo，包含核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务、原生桥接和第一方插件。可引导的 Linux 和 Android 发行版在单独的 elizaOS/os 仓库中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 Bun 和 Node.js，使用 Turbo 进行构建，支持子模块和补丁。
zh.hot: 本周新增 115 颗星，总星数达 19064，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 19 名。其“智能体操作系统”的定位和全栈能力吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者：使用 CLI 和文档构建自定义 AI 代理或插件
企业：通过 Eliza Cloud 部署和管理 AI 代理
个人用户：下载 Eliza 应用用于个人助理、自动化等场景
研究者：探索自主代理和操作系统级集成的可能性

en.tag: Open-source agentic operating system for autonomous AI agents
en.what: elizaOS is an open-source TypeScript framework and product stack for building and running autonomous AI agents. It provides a core runtime, the Eliza app, CLI, cloud services, and native bridges, enabling capabilities from chat and voice to device control.
en.content: This repository is a monorepo containing the core runtime, the Eliza app, the CLI, cloud services, native bridges, and first-party plugins. Bootable Linux and Android distributions live in a separate elizaOS/os repository.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Bun and Node.js dependencies, built using Turbo, supporting submodules and patches.
en.hot: Gained 115 stars this week, reaching 19,064 total, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) weekly. Its positioning as an 'agentic operating system' with full-stack capabilities attracts many developers.
uses: Developers: build custom AI agents or plugins using the CLI and docs
Enterprises: deploy and manage AI agents via Eliza Cloud
Individuals: download the Eliza app for personal assistant, automation, etc.
Researchers: explore autonomous agents and OS-level integration

zh.tag: 免费在线数据库 ER 图编辑器与 SQL 生成器
zh.what: drawDB 是一个在浏览器中运行的免费数据库实体关系图（ERD）编辑器，用户无需注册即可快速绘制数据库图表、导入导出 SQL 脚本、生成迁移脚本并自定义编辑器。它旨在简化数据库设计流程，让开发者可以直观地可视化和操作数据库结构。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 drawDB 前端应用源码，包括 React 组件、状态管理、样式和构建配置。还提供了本地开发、生产构建和 Docker 部署的脚本，以及可选的分享功能（需要配套的 drawdb-server）。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 和 React 构建，使用 npm 进行依赖管理和构建，支持 Docker 容器化部署。主要依赖包括 React 生态、状态管理库（如 Redux 或 MobX）以及代码编辑器组件（如 Monaco）。
zh.hot: drawDB 因其免费、无需注册、直接在浏览器中使用的便捷性而广受欢迎，star 数已达 38k+，今日新增 48 个，在 GitHub 趋势榜 JavaScript 类别中排名第 10。它解决了数据库设计中的常见痛点，提供了简洁直观的界面和强大的 SQL 生成功能。
uses: 数据库开发者：快速可视化数据库结构，生成 SQL 脚本和迁移文件。
软件架构师：在项目初期设计 ER 图，便于团队协作和沟通。
教育场景：用于教学演示数据库设计概念，无需安装复杂软件。
全栈开发者：在开发过程中快速原型化数据库模型，并导出为 SQL 语句。

en.tag: Free, simple, intuitive online database ER diagram editor and SQL generator
en.what: drawDB is a free, browser-based database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor that lets users quickly build diagrams, import/export SQL scripts, generate migrations, and customize the editor without creating an account. It simplifies database design by providing an intuitive visual interface for structuring and manipulating database schemas.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the drawDB frontend application, including React components, state management, styles, and build configuration. It provides scripts for local development, production build, and Docker deployment, along with optional sharing features that require a companion drawdb-server.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript and React, using npm for dependency management and build, with Docker support for containerized deployment. Key dependencies include React ecosystem, state management libraries (e.g., Redux or MobX), and code editor components (e.g., Monaco).
en.hot: drawDB has gained popularity for being free, requiring no sign-up, and working directly in the browser, amassing 38k+ stars with 48 new stars today, ranking #10 on GitHub Trending for JavaScript. It addresses common pain points in database design with a clean, intuitive interface and powerful SQL generation capabilities.
uses: Database developers: quickly visualize database schemas and generate SQL scripts and migrations.
Software architects: design ER diagrams in early project phases for team collaboration and communication.
Educational settings: demonstrate database design concepts without installing complex software.
Full-stack developers: prototype database models quickly during development and export to SQL statements.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理提供跨会话持久记忆的压缩与注入系统
zh.what: claude-mem 是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）提供持久记忆的系统。它捕获代理在会话中的所有操作，利用 AI 进行压缩，并在未来的会话中注入相关上下文，从而实现跨会话的连续记忆。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心的 JavaScript 实现、文档（支持多语言）、以及用于展示的静态网站资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js（>=20），使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 AI 模型进行上下文压缩。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的普及，跨会话记忆成为刚需，该项目以 90k+ stars 迅速走红，本周新增近千 star。
uses: Claude Code 用户希望保留长期项目上下文，避免重复描述需求。
开发者构建多会话 AI 工作流，需要记忆共享。
团队协作时，希望代理能记住团队偏好和项目历史。

en.tag: Persistent memory compression and injection system for AI agents

zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Go 代码、文档（特性、工作流、架构等）、截图和演示 GIF，以及用于自托管的配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，支持多种 AI 代理提供商（如 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot 等），并集成 Tailscale/VPN 实现远程访问。
zh.hot: 尽管 star 数不高（570），但因其多代理编排、自托管、无遥测等特性，在 Go 趋势榜上排名第 12，吸引了对 AI 代理工作流有深度控制需求的用户。
uses: 高级开发者：希望自定义 AI 代理工作流、提示词和审查门控的开发者。
团队协作：需要统一代理工作流并共享给团队成员的团队。
远程执行：希望在服务器上运行多个代理，并从手机等设备远程管理的用户。

en.tag: AI agent orchestration & kanban dev environment, self-hosted multi-agent
en.what: Kandev is a powerful tool for power users to manage and run AI agents in parallel, review changes, and open PRs. It organizes work via kanban and pipeline views, and provides an integrated workspace with file editor, terminal, browser preview, and git changes for reviewing agent output.
en.content: The repo contains core Go code, documentation (features, workflows, architecture), screenshots, demo GIF, and configuration for self-hosting.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, supports multiple AI agent providers (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, etc.), and integrates with Tailscale/VPN for remote access.
en.hot: Despite modest stars (570), it ranks #12 on Go trending due to its multi-agent orchestration, self-hosting, no telemetry, appealing to users needing deep control over AI agent workflows.
uses: Power developers: those wanting to customize AI agent workflows, prompts, and review gates.
Team collaboration: teams needing consistent agent workflows shared across members.
Remote execution: users who want to offload agent execution to servers and manage from anywhere.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 原生作业排队与准入管理
zh.what: Kueue 是一组 API 和控制器，用于在 Kubernetes 上实现作业级排队。它决定作业何时被准入（开始创建 Pod）以及何时停止（删除活跃 Pod），支持基于优先级的多种排队策略。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kueue 的控制器、API 定义、文档站点以及示例。核心概念包括 ClusterQueue、LocalQueue 和 Workload，提供公平共享、抢占、资源 flavor 互换等功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，使用 Kubernetes 的 controller-runtime 构建，与集群自动缩放器集成，支持 Prometheus 指标。
zh.hot: 随着 Kubernetes 上 AI/ML 工作负载（如 Kubeflow、Ray）的增多，对作业排队的需求上升。Kueue 作为 CNCF 沙箱项目，提供原生解决方案，今日新增 22 星，总星数 2827，持续受到关注。
uses: 平台团队：为多租户 Kubernetes 集群提供统一的作业排队和资源配额管理。
AI/ML 工程师：运行 Kubeflow、Ray 等训练作业，需要优先级和抢占控制。
SRE/运维：通过公平共享和队列策略优化集群资源利用率。

en.tag: Kubernetes-native job queueing and admission control
en.what: Kueue is a set of APIs and controllers for job-level queueing on Kubernetes. It decides when a job should be admitted (pods can be created) and when it should stop (active pods deleted), supporting priority-based queueing strategies.
en.content: The repo contains the Kueue controller, API definitions, documentation site, and examples. Core concepts include ClusterQueue, LocalQueue, and Workload, with features like fair sharing, preemption, and flavor fungibility.
en.stack: Developed in Go, built on Kubernetes controller-runtime, integrates with cluster-autoscaler, and supports Prometheus metrics.
en.hot: With the rise of AI/ML workloads on Kubernetes (e.g., Kubeflow, Ray), demand for job queueing grows. As a CNCF sandbox project, Kueue offers a native solution; gaining 22 stars today (total 2827) reflects sustained interest.
uses: Platform teams: provide unified job queueing and resource quota management for multi-tenant K8s clusters.
AI/ML engineers: run training jobs like Kubeflow or Ray with priority and preemption control.
SRE/ops: optimize cluster resource utilization via fair sharing and queue strategies.

zh.tag: 为家庭用户打造的开源物品库存与组织管理系统
zh.what: HomeBox 是一个专为家庭用户设计的库存与组织管理系统，旨在帮助用户轻松管理家中物品。它强调简单易用，同时具备可扩展性，支持物品分类、位置、标签、自定义字段、图片上传、文档与保修跟踪、购买与维护记录等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 HomeBox 应用源码，包括 Go 后端、嵌入式 Web UI、文档、Docker 部署配置以及截图等。提供演示站点和多种部署方式，如 Docker、PikaPods 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，后端采用 SQLite 数据库，前端为嵌入式 Web UI（可能使用 Vue/React 等），整体容器化部署，空闲内存占用低于 50MB。
zh.hot: HomeBox 在 GitHub 上持续受到关注，今日新增 88 星，总星数达 6773，位列 Go 语言日榜第 4。其简单、快速、便携的特点吸引了大量家庭用户和自托管爱好者。
uses: 家庭用户：管理家中物品、保修、文档等，适合整理收纳控。
自托管爱好者：可轻松部署在自己的服务器或 NAS 上，数据自主可控。
小型团队或组织：用于内部资产登记与追踪，轻量且高效。
开发者：可作为 Go + SQLite + Web UI 的参考项目，学习全栈开发。

en.tag: Open-source inventory and organization system for home users
en.what: HomeBox is an inventory and organization system built for home users, helping them easily manage household items. It emphasizes simplicity and ease of use while being expandable, supporting categories, locations, tags, custom fields, image uploads, document and warranty tracking, purchase and maintenance records, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full HomeBox application source code, including Go backend, embedded web UI, documentation, Docker deployment configs, and screenshots. It offers a demo site and multiple deployment options like Docker and PikaPods.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with SQLite as the database and an embedded web UI (likely Vue/React). The whole app is containerized, with idle memory usage under 50MB.
en.hot: HomeBox continues to gain traction on GitHub, with 88 stars today and 6,773 total, ranking #4 on the Go daily trending list. Its simplicity, speed, and portability appeal to home users and self-hosting enthusiasts.
uses: Home users: manage household items, warranties, documents, perfect for organization enthusiasts.
Self-hosters: easily deploy on own server or NAS for data control.
Small teams/organizations: lightweight asset tracking and management.
Developers: reference project for Go + SQLite + Web UI full-stack development.

zh.tag: AList 的社区驱动分叉，抵御信任危机
zh.what: OpenList 是 AList 的一个分叉，旨在通过社区驱动和长期治理来维护开源项目的透明性和可持续性。它提供文件列表与分享功能，并强调对信任危机的防御。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、多语言 README（中英日韩等）、贡献指南、行为准则和 AGPL-3.0 许可证。项目以 Go 编写，提供构建状态、版本发布和下载统计等徽章。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Cloudflare 提供的慈善资源用于文档和 API 服务。项目遵循 AGPL-3.0 许可证，并采用 GitHub Actions 进行构建。
zh.hot: 作为 AList 的社区驱动分叉，OpenList 在信任危机背景下迅速获得关注，24k+ 星标表明用户对透明治理和开源可持续性的强烈需求。
uses: 对 AList 原有功能有需求但希望避免信任风险的用户
关注开源项目治理和可持续性的开发者
需要文件列表与分享功能的个人或团队
希望参与社区驱动项目贡献的贡献者

en.tag: Community-driven fork of AList to counter trust crisis
en.what: OpenList is a fork of AList, designed to maintain transparency and sustainability through community-driven governance. It offers file listing and sharing capabilities, with a focus on defending against trust-based attacks.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, multilingual READMEs (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, etc.), contributing guidelines, code of conduct, and AGPL-3.0 license. Written in Go, it includes badges for build status, releases, and downloads.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relying on Cloudflare's charitable resources for documentation and API services. The project follows the AGPL-3.0 license and uses GitHub Actions for builds.
en.hot: As a community-driven fork of AList, OpenList quickly gained traction amid trust concerns, with 24k+ stars reflecting strong demand for transparent governance and open-source sustainability.
uses: Users needing AList features but wary of trust issues
Developers interested in open-source governance and sustainability
Individuals or teams requiring file listing and sharing
Contributors seeking community-driven projects to join

zh.tag: 把AI编码代理当队友分配任务的协作工作台
zh.what: Multica 是一个开源工作台，让你像给队友派活一样把 issue 分配给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 20 种编码代理。代理会自动接单、在可控运行时中工作、实时评论并交回审查，所有上下文和决策都关联到同一 issue。支持自托管，无锁定。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Go 后端、Web 前端（看板界面）、文档（README、自托管指南、愿景）、以及用于集成 20 种代理 CLI 的运行时适配器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 构建后端，前端为 Web 应用，支持多种代理 CLI 的集成，自托管部署。
zh.hot: 44.5k stars 且单日新增 274，登上 Go 趋势榜第二，因为解决了多代理协作中上下文丢失和重复解释的痛点，将代理真正纳入团队流程。
uses: 开发者团队：统一管理多个编码代理，减少切换和重复沟通成本
技术负责人：将代理分配为团队成员，通过看板跟踪进度和审查结果
自托管用户：对数据隐私有要求，希望完全掌控代理运行环境

en.tag: Assign issues to AI coding agents like teammates in an open-source workspace
en.what: Multica is an open-source workspace where you assign issues to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 20 others, just as you would to a teammate. Agents pick up issues, work in a runtime you control, comment as they go, and hand back for review, keeping context and decisions tied to the issue. Self-hostable with no lock-in.
en.content: The repo contains the core Go backend, a web frontend (board UI), documentation (README, self-hosting guide, vision), and runtime adapters for integrating 20 agent CLIs.
en.stack: Built primarily with Go for the backend, with a web frontend, and integrations for multiple agent CLIs; supports self-hosting.
en.hot: With 44.5k stars and +274 today, ranking #2 on Go trending, it solves the pain of context loss and repeated explanations when managing multiple agents, integrating them into team workflows.
uses: Dev teams: manage multiple coding agents in one place, reducing context switching and repeated explanations
Tech leads: assign agents as team members, track progress and review via board
Self-hosters: need data privacy and full control over agent runtimes

zh.tag: 内网穿透神器，快速反向代理
zh.what: frp 是一个高性能反向代理应用，用于将位于 NAT 或防火墙后面的本地服务器暴露到互联网。它支持 TCP、UDP、HTTP、HTTPS 协议，并可通过域名将请求转发到内部服务，还提供 P2P 连接模式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 frp 的完整源代码、文档（中英文）、配置示例、架构说明以及用于构建和测试的脚本。主要组件包括 frps（服务端）和 frpc（客户端），支持多种代理类型和高级功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖标准库和少量第三方库（如 yaml.v2、v2ray 等），支持跨平台编译，可运行于 Linux、Windows、macOS 等系统。
zh.hot: frp 是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的内网穿透工具，拥有超过 10 万 star，本月新增近千星，持续活跃。其稳定性、易用性和丰富的功能使其成为开发者和运维人员的首选。
uses: 开发人员：本地开发时快速将 Web 服务暴露给外部测试或演示
运维人员：将内网服务器（如 SSH、数据库）安全地暴露到公网
个人用户：远程访问家中 NAS、摄像头等设备
企业场景：在受限网络环境下提供安全的远程访问解决方案

en.tag: Fast reverse proxy for exposing local servers behind NAT/firewall
en.what: frp is a high-performance reverse proxy that exposes local servers behind NAT or firewall to the internet. It supports TCP, UDP, HTTP, and HTTPS protocols, forwards requests to internal services via domain names, and offers P2P connection mode.
en.content: The repository contains complete source code, documentation (Chinese and English), configuration examples, architecture descriptions, and build/test scripts. Main components include frps (server) and frpc (client), supporting various proxy types and advanced features.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, relying on standard library and a few third-party libraries (e.g., yaml.v2, v2ray), supports cross-platform compilation for Linux, Windows, macOS, etc.
en.hot: frp is the most popular intranet penetration tool on GitHub with over 100k stars, adding nearly a thousand this month and remaining highly active. Its stability, ease of use, and rich features make it the go-to choice for developers and DevOps.
uses: Developers: quickly expose local web services for external testing or demos
DevOps: securely expose internal servers (e.g., SSH, databases) to the public internet
Personal users: remotely access home NAS, cameras, etc.
Enterprise: provide secure remote access in restricted network environments

zh.tag: K8s 全生命周期安全平台，从开发到运行时的防护
zh.what: Kubescape 是一个开源的 Kubernetes 安全平台，覆盖 IDE、CI/CD 流水线和集群，提供风险分析、安全合规和错误配置扫描。它帮助用户节省时间、精力和资源，确保集群安全。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kubescape CLI 工具、扫描器、策略框架、运行时安全组件以及文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes API、OCI 镜像、ARMO 策略等。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 孵化项目，Kubescape 提供全面的安全覆盖，star 数持续增长，本周新增 22 星，位列 Go 周榜第 21 名。
uses: Kubernetes 管理员：用于集群安全合规和错误配置扫描。
DevOps 工程师：集成到 CI/CD 流水线进行安全左移。
安全团队：进行风险分析和运行时安全监控。
开发者：在 IDE 中快速检查 Kubernetes 配置安全。

en.tag: Comprehensive Kubernetes security platform from dev to runtime
en.what: Kubescape is an open-source Kubernetes security platform covering IDE, CI/CD pipelines, and clusters, offering risk analysis, security compliance, and misconfiguration scanning. It saves users time, effort, and resources while ensuring cluster security.
en.content: The repo contains the Kubescape CLI tool, scanners, policy framework, runtime security components, and documentation/examples.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Kubernetes API, OCI images, ARMO policies, etc.
en.hot: As a CNCF incubating project, Kubescape offers comprehensive security coverage, with steady star growth, adding 22 stars this week and ranking 21st on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Kubernetes administrators: for cluster security compliance and misconfiguration scanning.
DevOps engineers: integrate into CI/CD pipelines for shift-left security.
Security teams: for risk analysis and runtime security monitoring.
Developers: quick security checks on Kubernetes configs in IDE.

zh.tag: 云原生高性能消息系统服务器
zh.what: NATS Server 是 NATS.io 消息系统的高性能服务器实现，为分布式系统、服务和设备提供简单、安全、高效的通信。它支持云、边缘、本地甚至 Raspberry Pi 等环境，并拥有超过 40 种客户端语言实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NATS 服务器的核心代码，包括消息路由、集群、JetStream 持久化、安全认证等功能模块，以及 Dockerfile、配置文件示例和测试套件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 NATS 客户端库和测试工具，支持多种部署方式（二进制、Docker、Kubernetes）。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 项目，NATS 在云原生领域广受欢迎，本周新增 118 星，总星数超 2 万，因其高性能和边缘计算适用性而持续受到关注。
uses: 微服务架构中的消息通信和事件驱动系统
物联网设备与边缘计算场景的轻量级消息传递
需要高吞吐、低延迟消息中间件的云原生应用
作为 JetStream 提供持久化消息流和事件存储

en.tag: High-performance cloud-native messaging server
en.what: NATS Server is the high-performance server implementation of the NATS.io messaging system, providing simple, secure, and efficient communication for distributed systems, services, and devices. It runs on-premise, in the cloud, at the edge, and even on Raspberry Pi, with over 40 client language implementations.
en.content: The repository contains the core server code, including message routing, clustering, JetStream persistence, security authentication, along with Dockerfile, sample configs, and test suites.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging NATS client libraries and testing tools, supporting deployment via binaries, Docker, and Kubernetes.
en.hot: As a CNCF project, NATS is widely popular in cloud-native; with 118 stars added this week and over 20k total, its high performance and edge suitability keep it trending.
uses: Message communication and event-driven systems in microservices architecture
Lightweight messaging for IoT and edge computing scenarios
Cloud-native apps needing high-throughput, low-latency messaging middleware
Using JetStream for persistent message streams and event storage

zh.tag: 最强泄露凭证发现、验证与分析工具
zh.what: TruffleHog 是一款用于发现、验证和分析泄露凭证（如 API 密钥、数据库密码、私钥等）的安全工具。它能在 Git 仓库、聊天记录、wiki、日志等多种来源中扫描敏感信息，并对发现的凭证进行分类和验证，确认其是否仍然有效。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的命令行工具，核心是 pkg/detectors 目录下的 800 多种凭证检测器，以及用于扫描、分类、验证和分析的模块。还提供企业版产品用于持续监控多个平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 GoReleaser 进行构建发布，并集成了 Go Report Card 等质量工具。
zh.hot: 拥有 27415 颗星，今日新增 36 颗，位列 GitHub 趋势榜 Go 语言第 4 名。其强大的凭证检测能力和活跃的社区支持使其备受欢迎。
uses: 安全工程师：在代码库和 CI/CD 流程中扫描泄露的凭证，防止安全事故。
DevOps 团队：持续监控 Git、聊天工具等，确保敏感信息不泄露。
渗透测试人员：在授权测试中快速发现目标系统中的有效凭证。
开源贡献者：参与 800 多种检测器的维护和扩展。

en.tag: The most powerful leaked credential discovery, verification, and analysis tool
en.what: TruffleHog is a security tool for discovering, verifying, and analyzing leaked credentials such as API keys, database passwords, and private keys. It scans various sources like Git repos, chats, wikis, and logs, then classifies and validates the found secrets to confirm if they are still active.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based CLI tool with over 800 credential detectors in pkg/detectors, along with modules for scanning, classification, validation, and analysis. An enterprise product is also available for continuous monitoring across multiple platforms.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, using GoReleaser for builds and releases, and integrated with quality tools like Go Report Card.
en.hot: With 27,415 stars and 36 added today, it ranks 4th on GitHub Trending for Go. Its powerful credential detection and active community contribute to its popularity.
uses: Security engineers: scan codebases and CI/CD pipelines for leaked credentials to prevent breaches.
DevOps teams: continuously monitor Git, chats, etc., to ensure sensitive info isn't exposed.
Penetration testers: quickly find valid credentials in authorized security assessments.
Open source contributors: help maintain and expand the 800+ detectors.

zh.tag: Agent 技能评估与进化工具
zh.what: skill-up 是一个用于评估和进化 Agent 技能的工具。它通过声明式 YAML 用例在多个 Agent 引擎上运行评估，并利用 skill-upper 通过对话自动修复或扩展评估套件，实现持续迭代。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的核心二进制，支持 YAML 配置（eval.yaml + cases/*.yaml）、多引擎（Qoder CLI、Claude Code、Codex）、多种评判策略（rule_based、script、agent_judge），并输出结构化报告（grading.json、benchmark.json 等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 YAML 配置和多种 Agent 引擎（如 Claude Code、Codex），支持本地自定义引擎。
zh.hot: 本周新增 123 星，登上 Go 周榜第 16 名。作为阿里出品的 Agent 技能评估工具，填补了技能质量度量和自动进化的空白，吸引开发者关注。
uses: Agent 开发者：评估和优化自定义 Agent 技能的质量
AI 工程团队：在 CI 中集成技能回归测试，确保技能持续改进
研究者：通过自动化迭代探索技能进化方法

en.tag: Evaluation and evolution tool for Agent Skills
en.what: skill-up is a tool for evaluating and evolving Agent Skills. It runs declarative YAML cases across multiple Agent engines, and uses skill-upper to automatically repair or expand the eval suite through conversation, enabling continuous iteration.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-implemented core binary, supporting YAML config (eval.yaml + cases/*.yaml), multiple engines (Qoder CLI, Claude Code, Codex), flexible judging (rule_based, script, agent_judge), and structured reports (grading.json, benchmark.json, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relies on YAML configuration and multiple Agent engines (e.g., Claude Code, Codex), with support for custom local engines.
en.hot: Gained 123 stars this week, ranking #16 on the Go weekly trending. As an Alibaba-built tool for Agent skill evaluation, it fills a gap in skill quality measurement and auto-evolution, drawing developer attention.
uses: Agent developers: evaluate and optimize the quality of custom Agent skills
AI engineering teams: integrate skill regression testing in CI to ensure continuous improvement
Researchers: explore skill evolution methods through automated iteration

zh.tag: AI视频翻译配音全链路工具，支持人类与AI Agent调用
zh.what: KrillinAI 是一款由 Krillin AI 团队开发的音视频本地化与增强工具，面向人类用户和 AI Agent。它覆盖从视频下载、语音转录、字幕翻译、TTS 配音、人像转换到封面生成的完整流程，支持横竖屏格式，适配 B站、小红书、抖音、YouTube 等主流平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 客户端、分阶段命令接口、skills/ 目录提供各阶段 Agent Skills，以及多语言文档（中英日韩等）。支持一键端到端本地化，也可通过 CLI 分阶段调用，AI Agent 可按需编排。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 LLM 进行翻译，TTS 引擎进行配音，支持 100+ 语言。
zh.hot: 本周新增 384 星，总星数破万，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Go）第 19 名。其面向 AI Agent 的 Skills 设计和对多平台适配的完整流程吸引了大量关注。
uses: 内容创作者：一键翻译配音视频，快速发布到海外平台
AI Agent 开发者：利用 Skills 集成视频本地化能力到自动化工作流
本地化团队：批量处理多语言视频内容，提高效率

en.tag: Full-pipeline AI video translation & dubbing tool for humans and agents
en.what: KrillinAI is a versatile audio/video localization and enhancement tool by Krillin AI team, designed for both human users and AI Agents. It covers the complete pipeline including video download, speech transcription, subtitle translation, TTS dubbing, portrait conversion, and cover generation, supporting both landscape and portrait formats for major platforms like Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, YouTube, etc.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI client, phased command-line interface, skills/ directory with per-stage Agent Skills, and multi-language docs (EN, ZH, JP, etc.). It supports one-click end-to-end localization and phased CLI invocation for AI Agents to orchestrate.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging LLMs for translation and TTS engines for dubbing, supporting 100+ languages.
en.hot: Gained 384 stars this week, surpassing 10k total, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (Go). Its Agent Skills design and full multi-platform pipeline have drawn significant attention.
uses: Content creators: one-click translate and dub videos for global platforms
AI Agent developers: integrate video localization into automated workflows via Skills
Localization teams: batch process multi-language video content efficiently

zh.tag: 开源智能代码审查，基准测试第一
zh.what: PR-AF 是一个基于 AgentField 构建的开源智能代码审查工具，在 Martian Code-Review-Bench 上排名第一。它将每个 PR 转化为任务特定的审查计划，生成专注的审查代理，以代码证据为基础，挑战结果，从而从更便宜的模型中提取更多有用的审查情报。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心审查引擎、CLI 工具、Docker 部署支持、基准测试脚本和文档。支持通过 CLI、curl、CI 或 API 触发审查，并流式输出进度和结果。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，基于 AgentField 框架，支持多种模型（如 DeepSeek、GLM-5.2、Opus 类），可通过 Docker 自托管。
zh.hot: 在 Code-Review-Bench 上超越所有商业工具，成为开源第一，且审查成本比闭源工具低约 10 倍。本周新增 78 星，登上 GitHub 周榜。
uses: 开源项目维护者：希望用低成本获得高质量代码审查，提升代码质量。
CI/CD 集成：将 PR-AF 作为自动化审查步骤，在合并前捕获 bug。
AI 研究者：研究智能体代码审查的基准和方法。
企业团队：需要自托管、模型灵活的代码审查方案。

en.tag: Open-source agentic code review, #1 on Code-Review-Bench
en.what: PR-AF is an open-source agentic code review tool built on AgentField, ranking #1 on Martian Code-Review-Bench. It turns each PR into a task-specific review plan, spawns focused reviewer agents, grounds findings in code evidence, and challenges results to extract more useful review intelligence from cheaper models.
en.content: The repository includes the core review engine, CLI tool, Docker deployment support, benchmark scripts, and documentation. Reviews can be triggered via CLI, curl, CI, or API, with live progress streaming and result output.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, built on the AgentField framework, supports multiple models (e.g., DeepSeek, GLM-5.2, Opus-class), and can be self-hosted via Docker.
en.hot: It tops the Code-Review-Bench among all tools, becoming #1 open-source, with review costs about 10x cheaper than closed-source tools. Gained 78 stars this week, hitting the GitHub weekly trending list.
uses: Open-source maintainers: want high-quality code review at low cost to improve code quality.
CI/CD integration: use PR-AF as an automated review step to catch bugs before merge.
AI researchers: study benchmarks and methods for agentic code review.
Enterprise teams: need self-hosted, model-flexible code review solutions.

zh.tag: Go 语言精选框架、库与软件清单
zh.what: 这是一个精心整理的 Go 语言资源列表，收录了高质量的框架、库和软件，涵盖 Web 框架、数据库、命令行工具等多个类别。它旨在帮助 Go 开发者快速找到适合自己项目的工具和库。
zh.content: 仓库包含按类别组织的 README 文件，每个类别下列出相关项目并附有简介和链接。此外还有贡献指南和自动化测试，确保列表的质量和更新。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Markdown 和 GitHub 平台，使用 GitHub Actions 进行自动化测试，并依赖社区贡献来维护。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 社区最权威的资源列表，star 数高达 18 万，每周新增 746 星，持续吸引开发者关注，是 Go 开发者必备的参考。
uses: Go 开发者寻找合适的库或框架时参考
初学者了解 Go 生态系统的入门指南
技术团队评估工具选型时的资源池
贡献者分享和推广优质 Go 项目的平台

en.tag: Curated list of awesome Go frameworks, libraries, and software
en.what: A curated list of high-quality Go frameworks, libraries, and software, covering categories like web frameworks, databases, and CLI tools. It helps Go developers quickly find suitable tools and libraries for their projects.
en.content: The repository contains a README organized by categories, listing projects with brief descriptions and links. It also includes contribution guidelines and automated tests to maintain quality and freshness.

Beginners seeking an overview of the Go ecosystem
Technical teams evaluating tool options
Contributors sharing and promoting quality Go projects

zh.tag: 真正独立的现代网页浏览器，基于全新引擎
zh.what: Ladybird 是一个真正独立的网页浏览器，采用基于 Web 标准的新颖引擎，旨在构建完整、可用的现代浏览器。它目前处于预 alpha 阶段，仅适合开发者使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器的主要源代码，采用多进程架构，包括 UI 主进程、多个 WebContent 渲染进程、ImageDecoder 进程和 RequestServer 进程。核心库组件继承自 SerenityOS，如 LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SerenityOS 的多个库（LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等），支持 Linux、macOS、Windows（WSL2）等平台。
zh.hot: 作为真正独立的浏览器项目，Ladybird 在开发者中引起广泛关注，star 数已达 64,842，今日新增 42，位列 C++ 日榜第一。
uses: 对浏览器引擎感兴趣的开发者，可以学习其架构和实现。
希望参与开源浏览器项目贡献的开发者。
关注 Web 标准和技术前沿的技术爱好者。

en.tag: A truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine
en.what: Ladybird is a truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine, aiming to build a complete, usable browser for the modern web. It is currently in pre-alpha state and only suitable for developers.
en.content: The repository contains the main source code of the browser, using a multi-process architecture with a main UI process, several WebContent renderer processes, an ImageDecoder process, and a RequestServer process. Core library components are inherited from SerenityOS, such as LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on several SerenityOS libraries (LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.), supporting Linux, macOS, Windows (with WSL2), and other *NIXes.
en.hot: As a truly independent browser project, Ladybird has gained significant attention among developers, with 64,842 stars and 42 new stars today, ranking first on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Developers interested in browser engines, to learn its architecture and implementation.
Developers who want to contribute to an open-source browser project.
Tech enthusiasts following web standards and cutting-edge technology.

zh.tag: 原生集成AI代理的Windows终端
zh.what: Intelligent Terminal是Windows Terminal的实验性分支，原生集成了AI代理功能。它支持任何符合Agent Client Protocol (ACP)的代理CLI，如GitHub Copilot CLI，使用户能在命令行中直接与AI交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的终端应用源码，基于Windows Terminal，新增了代理状态栏、代理面板、代理管理、错误检测和命令面板等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++开发，依赖Windows Terminal的代码库，并遵循ACP协议与代理CLI通信。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方项目，将AI代理直接集成到终端，吸引了大量开发者关注，今日新增26星，登上GitHub Trending C++日榜第三。
uses: 开发者：在命令行中直接使用AI代理辅助编码，如代码生成、错误排查。
Windows用户：喜欢Windows Terminal但希望集成AI功能的用户。
AI爱好者：希望体验ACP协议和AI代理集成的新兴技术。

en.tag: Windows Terminal fork with native AI agent integration
en.what: Intelligent Terminal is an experimental fork of Windows Terminal with native agent integration. It works with any Agent Client Protocol (ACP)-compatible agent CLI, such as GitHub Copilot CLI, enabling direct AI interaction within the command line.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the terminal application, based on Windows Terminal, with added features like agent status bar, agent pane, agent management, error detection, and command palette.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, building upon the Windows Terminal codebase, and communicates with agent CLIs via the ACP protocol.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft project, it integrates AI agents directly into the terminal, attracting significant developer attention with 26 stars today, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending for C++.
uses: Developers: Use AI agents directly in the command line for coding assistance, such as code generation and error debugging.
Windows users: Those who like Windows Terminal but want integrated AI features.
AI enthusiasts: Those interested in experiencing ACP protocol and emerging AI agent integration.

zh.tag: 1-bit LLM 官方推理框架，CPU 上高效运行
zh.what: BitNet 是微软推出的 1-bit 大语言模型推理框架，旨在让超低比特量化模型在 CPU 上高效运行。它支持 BitNet b1.58 等三元模型，并提供优化的内核和工具链，实现接近全精度模型的性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理引擎（C++ 实现）、CPU 和 GPU 内核、模型转换工具、示例代码，以及针对嵌入模型的 I2_S 量化支持。还发布了 BitNet-embedding 系列模型和 VibeASR.cpp 等衍生项目。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 OpenMP 等并行库，支持 x86 (AVX2) 和 ARM (NEON) 指令集，并提供 Python 绑定。
zh.hot: BitNet 代表了 LLM 推理的极低比特量化方向，能大幅降低内存和计算需求，在 CPU 上实现高效推理。近 4 万星标表明社区对边缘部署和成本优化的强烈兴趣。
uses: 在无 GPU 的服务器或边缘设备上部署 LLM，降低硬件成本
需要低延迟、高吞吐的 CPU 推理场景，如实时语音识别（VibeASR）
研究低比特量化技术和模型压缩的开发者
构建嵌入模型应用，利用 BitNet-embedding 加速检索

en.tag: Official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, efficient on CPU
en.what: BitNet is Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, enabling efficient CPU deployment of ternary models like BitNet b1.58. It provides optimized kernels and tooling to achieve near-full-precision performance.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference engine (C++), CPU and GPU kernels, model conversion tools, examples, and I2_S quantization support for embedding models. It also hosts BitNet-embedding models and VibeASR.cpp.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with OpenMP for parallelism, supporting x86 (AVX2) and ARM (NEON), and offering Python bindings.
en.hot: BitNet represents the extreme low-bit quantization direction for LLM inference, drastically reducing memory and compute needs while enabling efficient CPU inference. Its ~40k stars reflect strong community interest in edge deployment and cost optimization.
uses: Deploy LLMs on CPU-only servers or edge devices to cut hardware costs
Low-latency, high-throughput CPU inference scenarios like real-time ASR (VibeASR)
Developers researching low-bit quantization and model compression
Build embedding-based applications with accelerated retrieval via BitNet-embedding

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: 统一云端与本地离线推理的跨平台 AI 客户端
zh.what: 这是一个生产就绪的跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，支持在 Android 设备上本地运行 GGUF 模型（GPU 加速，无需联网），同时可无缝切换到 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Gemini 或 Kimi 等云端 API。它提供多模态聊天、持久化会话、后台任务和智能自动配置等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Flutter 应用源码，包括 UI 层（聊天、任务、模型、设置视图）、GetX 控制器、服务层（本地推理、云服务、下载服务）以及推理管线的架构说明。
zh.stack: 基于 Flutter 3.x（Dart >=3.3.0），使用 GetX 管理状态，Hive 本地存储，Dio 网络请求，以及 Firebase 消息推送。本地推理依赖 Vulkan 加速。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 日榜（C++）排名第 5，今日新增 23 星，总星数 834。其亮点是同时支持本地离线运行和云端 API，且针对多种 Android 设备进行了图像生成测试，满足了用户对隐私和灵活性的需求。
uses: 注重隐私的用户：希望在本地运行模型，避免数据上传到云端。
移动开发者：需要参考 Flutter 跨平台 AI 客户端架构和本地推理集成。
AI 爱好者：希望在没有网络或低配设备上体验 LLM 和图像生成。

en.tag: Unified cross-platform AI client bridging cloud APIs and on-device offline LLM inference
en.what: A production-ready cross-platform AI chat client that runs GGUF models locally on Android with GPU acceleration (no internet after download) and seamlessly switches to cloud APIs like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or Kimi. It offers multimodal chat, persistent sessions, background tasks, and smart auto-configuration.
en.content: The repository contains the complete Flutter app source code, including UI layer (chat, task, model, settings views), GetX controllers, service layer (local inference, cloud service, download service), and architecture documentation for the inference pipeline.
en.stack: Built with Flutter 3.x (Dart >=3.3.0), uses GetX for state management, Hive for local storage, Dio for networking, and Firebase for push notifications. Local inference relies on Vulkan acceleration.
en.hot: Ranked #5 on GitHub Trending (C++) with 23 stars today and 834 total. Its appeal lies in combining local offline execution with cloud API fallback, tested on various Android devices for image generation, addressing privacy and flexibility needs.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to run models locally without data leaving their device.
Mobile developers looking for a reference Flutter cross-platform AI client architecture and local inference integration.
AI enthusiasts who want to experiment with LLMs and image generation offline or on low-end devices.

zh.tag: 赛博朋克2077的6自由度VR模组，真立体渲染
zh.what: 这是一个为《赛博朋克2077》打造的VR模组，作为RED4ext插件实现，提供真正的立体渲染（非重投影）、OpenXR头部追踪、全身VR化身、VR武器瞄准、动作近战等沉浸式功能。它通过头显内的F10覆盖菜单进行配置，并支持SteamVR和OpenXR运行时。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个主要插件：CyberpunkVR_Stereo负责立体渲染和头部追踪，CyberpunkVR_Hands驱动全身化身和手部控制；此外还有CET/redscript模组实现VR武器瞄准、近战、HUD等。文档目录提供了工程笔记和发布说明。
zh.stack: 基于C++开发，依赖RED4ext和Cyber Engine Tweaks，使用OpenXR/OpenVR API，集成DLSS/NGX，并涉及redscript脚本。
zh.hot: 本周新增36星，登上GitHub Trending C++榜第6名。它实现了真正的立体渲染而非重投影，是赛博朋克2077社区中技术含量极高的VR模组，吸引了大量VR玩家和模组爱好者。
uses: VR玩家：想要以第一人称沉浸式体验夜之城，支持全身追踪和真实瞄准。
模组开发者：学习RED4ext插件开发、立体渲染管线集成和OpenXR交互。
赛博朋克2077爱好者：尝试社区实验性模组，获得全新游戏体验。

en.tag: 6-DoF VR mod for Cyberpunk 2077 with real stereo rendering
en.what: This is a VR mod for Cyberpunk 2077, built as a RED4ext plugin, offering true stereo rendering (not reprojection), OpenXR head tracking, full-body VR avatar, VR weapon aiming, motion melee, and other immersive features. It is configured via an in-headset F10 overlay and supports both SteamVR and OpenXR runtimes.
en.content: The repo contains two main plugins: CyberpunkVR_Stereo handles stereo rendering and head tracking, CyberpunkVR_Hands drives the full-body avatar and hand controls; plus CET/redscript mods for VR weapon aiming, melee, HUD, etc. The docs folder provides engineering notes and release notes.
en.stack: Developed in C++, depends on RED4ext and Cyber Engine Tweaks, uses OpenXR/OpenVR APIs, integrates DLSS/NGX, and involves redscript scripting.
en.hot: Gained 36 stars this week, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending for C++. It achieves true stereo rendering instead of reprojection, making it a highly technical VR mod in the Cyberpunk 2077 community, attracting VR gamers and modders.
uses: VR gamers: want an immersive first-person experience in Night City with full-body tracking and realistic aiming.
Mod developers: learn RED4ext plugin development, stereo rendering pipeline integration, and OpenXR interaction.
Cyberpunk 2077 fans: try an experimental community mod for a fresh gameplay experience.

zh.tag: 基于机器学习的视频超分辨率与补帧工具
zh.what: Video2X 是一个利用机器学习模型对视频进行超分辨率放大和帧插值的框架。它通过调用 Anime4K、Real-ESRGAN 等算法提升视频画质，并支持补帧使播放更流畅。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C/C++ 重写代码，提供 Windows 和 Linux 的跨平台支持，带有 GUI 和安装程序，以及命令行工具。支持多种超分辨率和补帧模型，如 Anime4K、Real-ESRGAN、Real-CUGAN 和 RIFE。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C/C++ 编写，依赖 ncnn 和 Vulkan 进行 GPU 加速，支持自定义 GLSL 着色器。需要支持 AVX2 的 CPU 和支持 Vulkan 的 GPU。
zh.hot: 6.0 版本完全重写，性能大幅提升，跨平台支持更好，输出质量显著改善，吸引了大量用户。目前 star 数已超过 2 万，今日新增 31，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。
uses: 动漫爱好者：提升动漫视频分辨率和流畅度
视频创作者：修复老旧视频或低清素材
技术爱好者：探索机器学习在视频处理中的应用

en.tag: ML-based video upscaling and frame interpolation framework
en.what: Video2X is a framework that uses machine learning models to upscale videos and interpolate frames. It enhances video quality with algorithms like Anime4K and Real-ESRGAN, and supports frame interpolation for smoother playback.
en.content: The repository contains a complete C/C++ rewrite with cross-platform support for Windows and Linux, including a GUI, installer, and command-line tools. It supports various upscaling and interpolation models like Anime4K, Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN, and RIFE.
en.stack: Written primarily in C/C++, it leverages ncnn and Vulkan for GPU acceleration, and supports custom GLSL shaders. Requires AVX2-capable CPU and Vulkan-capable GPU.
en.hot: The 6.0 rewrite brought significant performance improvements, better cross-platform support, and enhanced output quality, attracting many users. With over 20k stars and 31 new stars today, it ranks #3 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Anime fans: upscale and smooth anime videos
Video creators: restore old or low-res footage
Tech enthusiasts: explore ML in video processing

zh.tag: 面向移动端与穿戴设备的混合边缘-云 AI 推理引擎
zh.what: Cactus 是一个专为移动设备、穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人设计的 AI 推理引擎，支持文本、语音和视觉任务。它采用混合边缘-云架构，在设备端运行量化模型，必要时可无缝切换至云端模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含四个核心组件：Cactus Engine（提供 OpenAI 兼容 API）、Cactus Graph（零拷贝计算图）、Cactus Kernels（针对 Apple、Samsung、Pixel 等设备的 CPU/GPU 内核）、Cactus Quants（基于旋转的量化技术）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，支持跨平台（包括 Mac、移动设备等）。集成了量化、内核优化和推理运行时，并提供 Python 绑定（可能）。
zh.hot: 凭借 5738 颗星和今日新增 22 颗星，Cactus 因填补了移动端高效 AI 推理的空白而受到关注，其混合边缘-云架构和独特的旋转量化技术吸引了开发者。
uses: 移动应用开发者：在 iOS/Android 应用中集成本地 AI 能力，如聊天、语音识别。
硬件厂商：为智能家居、机器人等设备提供低延迟、低功耗的 AI 推理方案。
边缘计算研究者：探索混合边缘-云推理和新型量化技术的实践。

en.tag: Hybrid edge-cloud AI engine for mobile, wearables, and robots
en.what: Cactus is an AI inference engine designed for mobile devices, wearables, smart home, and robots, supporting text, speech, and vision tasks. It uses a hybrid edge-cloud architecture, running quantized models on-device with seamless cloud handoff when needed.
en.content: The repo contains four core components: Cactus Engine (OpenAI-compatible APIs), Cactus Graph (zero-copy computation graph), Cactus Kernels (CPU/GPU kernels for Apple, Samsung, Pixel, etc.), and Cactus Quants (custom rotation-based quantization).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with CMake, cross-platform (including Mac and mobile). Integrates quantization, kernel optimization, and inference runtime, with possible Python bindings.
en.hot: With 5,738 stars and 22 new stars today, Cactus gains attention for filling the gap in efficient on-device AI inference, attracting developers with its hybrid edge-cloud architecture and unique rotation-based quantization.
uses: Mobile app developers: integrate on-device AI capabilities like chat and speech recognition into iOS/Android apps.
Hardware vendors: provide low-latency, low-power AI inference for smart home and robotics devices.
Edge computing researchers: explore hybrid edge-cloud inference and novel quantization techniques in practice.

zh.tag: 在 AMD Ryzen AI NPU 上分钟级运行大模型的轻量运行时
zh.what: FastFlowLM 是一个专为 AMD Ryzen AI NPU 深度优化的 LLM 运行时，支持视觉、音频、嵌入和 MoE 模型。无需 GPU，功耗降低 10 倍以上，支持最长 256k 上下文，安装包仅 17 MB，20 秒内即可完成安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Windows 安装程序（flm-setup.msi）、Linux 入门指南、文档、基准测试和模型列表，以及 CLI 工具（如 flm run 和 flm pull）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 AMD NPU 驱动（>=32.0.203.304）和 HuggingFace 下载优化模型内核。
zh.hot: 本周新增 58 星，登上 C++ 周榜第 9，因其填补了 AMD NPU 上运行 LLM 的空白，提供类似 Ollama 的体验但专为 NPU 优化，吸引开发者和 AI 爱好者。
uses: AMD Ryzen AI 笔记本用户：无需 GPU 即可本地运行大模型，功耗更低
开发者：快速测试和部署 LLM 应用，支持 CLI 和多种模型
AI 爱好者：探索 NPU 加速的本地 AI 推理，支持视觉和音频模型

en.tag: Run LLMs on AMD Ryzen AI NPUs in minutes with an ultra-lightweight, NPU-first runtime
en.what: FastFlowLM is an NPU-first runtime built exclusively for AMD Ryzen AI, supporting vision, audio, embedding, and MoE models. It requires no GPU, is over 10x more power-efficient, supports context lengths up to 256k tokens, and installs in under 20 seconds with a 17 MB footprint.
en.content: The repo includes a Windows installer (flm-setup.msi), Linux getting-started guide, docs, benchmarks, model list, and CLI tools (e.g., flm run and flm pull).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on AMD NPU drivers (>=32.0.203.304) and downloads optimized model kernels from HuggingFace.
en.hot: With 58 stars added this week and ranking #9 on the C++ weekly trending, it fills the gap for running LLMs on AMD NPUs, offering an Ollama-like experience optimized for NPUs, attracting developers and AI enthusiasts.
uses: AMD Ryzen AI laptop users: run LLMs locally without a GPU, with lower power consumption
Developers: quickly test and deploy LLM apps via CLI with multiple model support
AI enthusiasts: explore NPU-accelerated local inference, including vision and audio models

zh.tag: 高性能AI驱动实时媒体服务器
zh.what: SRS是一个简单、高性能、AI驱动的实时媒体服务器，支持RTMP、WebRTC、HLS、HTTP-FLV、SRT、MPEG-DASH和GB28181等多种协议，以及H.264、H.265、AV1、VP9、AAC、Opus和G.711等编解码器。它旨在提供低延迟、高并发的流媒体服务，适用于直播、会议、监控等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含SRS服务器的完整源代码、文档、Docker镜像、示例配置和测试工具。主要目录包括trunk（核心代码）、doc（文档）、以及用于构建和测试的脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++编写，支持Linux和macOS，跨多种架构（x86_64, ARMv7, AArch64, Apple M1, RISC-V, LoongArch, MIPS）。依赖FFmpeg、OpenSSL等第三方库，提供Docker部署方式。
zh.hot: SRS拥有29k+星标，因其强大的功能、跨平台支持和AI驱动特性而广受欢迎。本周新增35星，位列C++周榜第14，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 直播平台开发者：需要搭建低延迟直播服务的团队
视频会议系统：利用WebRTC支持实时音视频通信
监控安防：通过GB28181接入监控摄像头流
边缘计算：在多种硬件架构上部署媒体服务

en.tag: High-performance AI-driven real-time media server
en.what: SRS is a simple, high-performance, AI-driven real-time media server supporting RTMP, WebRTC, HLS, HTTP-FLV, SRT, MPEG-DASH, and GB28181, with codecs including H.264, H.265, AV1, VP9, AAC, Opus, and G.711. It aims to provide low-latency, high-concurrency streaming for live, conferencing, and surveillance use cases.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, Docker images, example configs, and testing tools for the SRS server. Key directories include trunk (core code), doc (docs), and build/test scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, supports Linux and macOS across x86_64, ARMv7, AArch64, Apple M1, RISC-V, LoongArch, and MIPS. Depends on FFmpeg, OpenSSL, and other third-party libraries; offers Docker deployment.
en.hot: With 29k+ stars, SRS is popular for its robust features, cross-platform support, and AI-driven capabilities. Gaining 35 stars this week, it ranks #14 on the C++ weekly trending, continuing to attract developer attention.
uses: Live streaming developers: teams needing low-latency live services
Video conferencing: leveraging WebRTC for real-time AV communication
Surveillance: integrating camera streams via GB28181
Edge computing: deploying media services on diverse hardware architectures

zh.tag: 跨平台 2D/3D 开源游戏引擎
zh.what: Godot 是一款功能丰富的跨平台游戏引擎，支持从统一界面创建 2D 和 3D 游戏。它提供了一套全面的常用工具，让用户专注于游戏开发，无需重复造轮子。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Godot 引擎的完整源代码、编辑器、导出模板以及官方文档和演示示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenGL/Vulkan 等图形 API，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 及 Web 平台。
zh.hot: 作为完全免费开源、无版税的游戏引擎，Godot 社区活跃，本月新增近 2000 星，持续吸引独立开发者和小型团队。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速制作 2D/3D 游戏并一键导出到多平台
游戏教育 —— 学习游戏开发原理，无需付费或授权
小型工作室 —— 低成本开发商业游戏，保留全部知识产权

en.tag: Cross-platform 2D and 3D open-source game engine
en.what: Godot Engine is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for creating 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It provides a comprehensive set of common tools, allowing users to focus on making games without reinventing the wheel.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, editor, export templates, official documentation, and demo projects for the Godot Engine.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on graphics APIs like OpenGL/Vulkan, and supports Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
en.hot: As a completely free and open-source game engine with no royalties, Godot has an active community, gaining nearly 2000 stars this month, continuously attracting indie developers and small teams.
uses: Indie game developers — quickly create 2D/3D games and export to multiple platforms with one click
Game education — learn game development principles without licensing fees
Small studios — develop commercial games at low cost while retaining full IP

zh.tag: Cloudflare Workers 开源运行时，自托管与本地开发利器
zh.what: workerd 是 Cloudflare Workers 背后的 JavaScript/Wasm 服务器运行时，基于 V8 引擎构建。它支持将 Workers 应用部署到自有服务器，也可作为开发工具在本地测试，还能充当可编程 HTTP 代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含 workerd 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置，以及用于构建和测试的脚本。核心是 C++ 实现的运行时，提供基于标准 Web API 的 Workers 执行环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 V8 引擎（JavaScript/Wasm），支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。构建系统采用 Bazel。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare Workers 的开源核心，workerd 吸引了大量开发者和企业关注，今日新增 57 星，总星数 8519，在 C++ 日榜排名第 8。其独特的 nanoservices 架构和兼容性设计是亮点。
uses: 自托管 Workers 应用：将原本部署在 Cloudflare 上的代码迁移到自己的服务器。
本地开发与测试：在本地模拟 Workers 环境，加快迭代。
可编程 HTTP 代理：用于请求拦截、修改和路由。
学习 Cloudflare Workers 内部机制：研究其设计原理和实现。

en.tag: Open-source runtime powering Cloudflare Workers for self-hosting and local dev
en.what: workerd is the JavaScript/Wasm server runtime that powers Cloudflare Workers, built on V8. It enables self-hosting Workers applications, local development and testing, and can act as a programmable HTTP proxy.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configs, and build/test scripts for workerd. The core is a C++ runtime providing a Workers execution environment based on standard Web APIs.
en.stack: Primarily C++, depends on V8 for JS/Wasm, supports Linux, macOS, and Windows. Build system uses Bazel.
en.hot: As the open-source core of Cloudflare Workers, workerd attracts developers and enterprises; +57 stars today, 8519 total, #8 on C++ daily trending. Its nanoservices architecture and compatibility design stand out.
uses: Self-host Workers apps: migrate code from Cloudflare to your own servers.
Local development: simulate the Workers environment for faster iteration.
Programmable HTTP proxy: intercept, modify, and route requests.
Learn Workers internals: study its design principles and implementation.

zh.tag: 跨平台 Telegram 客户端开发库
zh.what: TDLib 是一个用于构建 Telegram 客户端的跨平台库，支持几乎所有编程语言。它封装了网络、加密和本地存储等复杂细节，提供简单易用的 API。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 库、Java 和 .NET 绑定、JSON 接口、示例代码、构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 C++17，依赖 OpenSSL 和 zlib，支持 CMake 构建。
zh.hot: 作为 Telegram 官方推荐的客户端开发库，star 数已超 9000，本周新增 32，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Telegram 客户端开发者，需要跨平台支持
需要高性能、可靠消息处理的机器人开发者
希望在多种语言中集成 Telegram 功能的团队

en.tag: Cross-platform library for building Telegram clients
en.what: TDLib is a cross-platform library for building Telegram clients, usable from almost any programming language. It handles network, encryption, and local storage, offering a simple API.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ library, Java and .NET bindings, JSON interface, examples, build scripts, and documentation.
en.stack: Built on C++17, depends on OpenSSL and zlib, supports CMake.
en.hot: As the official library for Telegram clients, it has over 9000 stars, with 32 new this week, consistently attracting developers.
uses: Developers building Telegram clients needing cross-platform support
Bot developers requiring high-performance and reliable messaging
Teams integrating Telegram features in multiple languages

zh.tag: Telegram 官方桌面客户端完整源码
zh.what: 这是 Telegram 官方桌面客户端的完整源代码和构建说明，基于 Telegram API 和 MTProto 安全协议。它提供了跨平台的消息、语音和视频通话等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含所有源代码、构建脚本、依赖项说明以及针对 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的发布版本。还包括对旧系统版本的支持说明。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Qt 6/5.15、OpenSSL、WebRTC、zlib 等第三方库。
zh.hot: 作为 Telegram 官方客户端，拥有 3.26 万星标，持续更新，本周新增 80 星，位列 C++ 周榜第 15 名，体现了其高人气和活跃开发。
uses: Telegram 用户：获取官方桌面客户端的最新版本或自行构建。
开发者：学习大型 C++ 跨平台应用架构及 Telegram API 集成。
安全研究者：审查 MTProto 协议实现和客户端安全性。

en.tag: Official Telegram desktop client full source code
en.what: This is the complete source code and build instructions for the official Telegram desktop client, based on the Telegram API and MTProto secure protocol. It offers cross-platform messaging, voice and video calls, and more.
en.content: The repository contains all source code, build scripts, dependency descriptions, and release builds for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It also includes support notes for older system versions.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, it depends on Qt 6/5.15, OpenSSL, WebRTC, zlib, and other third-party libraries.
en.hot: As the official Telegram client, it has 32.6k stars, continuously updated, with 80 new stars this week, ranking 15th on the C++ weekly list, reflecting its popularity and active development.
uses: Telegram users: Get the latest official desktop client or build it yourself.
Developers: Learn large-scale C++ cross-platform app architecture and Telegram API integration.
Security researchers: Review MTProto protocol implementation and client security.

zh.tag: 跨平台高性能机器学习推理与训练加速器
zh.what: ONNX Runtime 是微软开源的机器学习推理与训练加速引擎，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow 等深度学习框架以及 scikit-learn 等经典 ML 库导出的模型。它通过图优化和硬件加速器利用，在不同设备上提供最佳性能，并支持多节点 GPU 训练加速。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 ONNX Runtime 源码、文档、示例和发布信息，涵盖推理与训练两大模块，并提供多种执行提供程序（如 QNN）的插件支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种硬件和操作系统，依赖 ONNX 格式，并集成 CUDA、TensorRT 等加速库。
zh.hot: 作为 AI 推理的关键基础设施，ONNX Runtime 持续获得开发者关注，今日新增 11 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 10，其稳定性和跨框架支持是长期热度所在。
uses: 需要跨平台部署模型的 AI 工程师，可加速推理并降低成本
使用 PyTorch 训练 Transformer 模型的研究者，可一键加速多节点 GPU 训练
在边缘设备或异构硬件上运行模型的开发者，利用硬件加速器优化性能
希望统一不同框架模型推理流程的团队，通过 ONNX 格式实现互操作

en.tag: Cross-platform, high-performance ML inference and training accelerator
en.what: ONNX Runtime is Microsoft's open-source ML inference and training acceleration engine, supporting models from deep learning frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow, as well as classical ML libraries. It leverages graph optimizations and hardware accelerators to deliver optimal performance across devices, and accelerates multi-node GPU training for transformer models.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, docs, examples, and release info for ONNX Runtime, covering both inference and training modules, with plugin support for various execution providers like QNN.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, supports multiple hardware and OS, depends on ONNX format, and integrates acceleration libraries like CUDA and TensorRT.
en.hot: As key infrastructure for AI inference, ONNX Runtime maintains steady developer interest, gaining 11 stars today and ranking #10 on the C++ daily trending list, with its stability and cross-framework support driving long-term popularity.
uses: AI engineers deploying models cross-platform with faster inference and lower costs
Researchers training transformer models in PyTorch, accelerating multi-node GPU training with one line
Developers running models on edge or heterogeneous hardware, leveraging hardware accelerators
Teams unifying inference across frameworks via ONNX format for interoperability

zh.tag: 苹果芯片上的机器学习数组框架
zh.what: MLX 是苹果机器学习研究团队推出的面向 Apple 芯片的数组框架，提供类似 NumPy 的 Python API 以及 C++、C、Swift API。它支持自动微分、自动向量化、惰性计算和动态图构建，并采用统一内存模型，可在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 实现、Python 绑定、高层包（如 mlx.nn 和 mlx.optimizers）、文档和示例。示例涵盖 Transformer 训练、LLaMA 推理与 LoRA 微调、Stable Diffusion 图像生成和 Whisper 语音识别等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，提供 Python、C、Swift API。依赖包括 Metal 和 Accelerate 框架，用于 GPU 加速和高效计算。
zh.hot: 作为苹果官方开源的机器学习框架，MLX 在 Apple 生态中备受关注，star 数已达 2.79 万。其统一内存和动态图设计使其在 Apple 芯片上训练和部署模型非常高效，吸引了大量研究人员和开发者。
uses: Apple 平台上的机器学习研究人员，希望快速实验新想法。
在 Mac 上训练或微调大语言模型（如 LLaMA）的开发者。
需要利用 Apple 芯片 GPU 进行高性能计算的工程师。
对 NumPy/PyTorch 熟悉，希望在 Apple 设备上无缝迁移的用户。

en.tag: Array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon
en.what: MLX is an array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon, developed by Apple's ML research team. It offers NumPy-like Python APIs along with C++, C, and Swift APIs, supporting automatic differentiation, vectorization, lazy computation, and dynamic graph construction. With a unified memory model, it runs efficiently on both CPU and GPU.
en.content: The repo contains core C++ implementation, Python bindings, high-level packages (mlx.nn, mlx.optimizers), documentation, and examples. Examples include Transformer training, LLaMA inference with LoRA fine-tuning, Stable Diffusion image generation, and Whisper speech recognition.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Python, C, and Swift APIs. It leverages Metal and Accelerate frameworks for GPU acceleration and efficient computation.
en.hot: As Apple's official open-source ML framework, MLX has gained significant attention in the Apple ecosystem, reaching 27.9k stars. Its unified memory and dynamic graph design make it highly efficient for training and deploying models on Apple silicon, attracting researchers and developers.
uses: ML researchers on Apple platforms seeking rapid experimentation.
Developers training or fine-tuning LLMs (e.g., LLaMA) on Mac.
Engineers needing high-performance compute on Apple silicon GPUs.
Users familiar with NumPy/PyTorch wanting seamless migration to Apple devices.

zh.tag: GPU 多卡通信原语库，高性能集合通信
zh.what: NCCL 是一个独立的 GPU 通信库，实现了 all-reduce、all-gather、reduce、broadcast、reduce-scatter 以及任意 send/receive 通信模式。它针对 PCIe、NVLink、NVswitch 以及 InfiniBand 或 TCP/IP 网络进行了优化，支持单节点或多节点任意数量的 GPU，可用于单进程或多进程（如 MPI）应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NCCL 库的源代码、构建脚本（支持 Debian/RPM/txz 包和 Python wheel）、测试工具（通过单独的 nccl-tests 仓库）以及文档。主要目录包括 src/（核心实现）、makefiles/（构建配置）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CUDA 工具链，支持多种 GPU 架构（通过 NVCC_GENCODE 配置）。构建系统基于 Makefile，可生成多种格式的安装包。
zh.hot: NCCL 是 NVIDIA 官方的高性能 GPU 通信库，是深度学习分布式训练的关键组件，几乎所有主流框架（如 PyTorch、TensorFlow）都依赖它。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但长期保持高关注度，在 C++ 日榜中排名第四。
uses: 深度学习工程师：在多 GPU 或多节点环境下训练大规模模型，需要高效集合通信。
HPC 开发者：构建高性能计算应用，利用 GPU 集群进行并行计算。
框架开发者：集成 NCCL 以优化分布式训练性能。
研究人员：需要了解或定制 GPU 通信原语以进行实验。

en.tag: Optimized primitives for collective multi-GPU communication
en.what: NCCL is a stand-alone library of standard communication routines for GPUs, implementing all-reduce, all-gather, reduce, broadcast, reduce-scatter, and any send/receive based communication pattern. It is optimized for high bandwidth on platforms using PCIe, NVLink, NVswitch, and networking via InfiniBand or TCP/IP, supporting any number of GPUs in a single node or across multiple nodes, and usable in single- or multi-process (e.g., MPI) applications.
en.content: The repository contains the NCCL library source code, build scripts (for Debian/RPM/txz packages and Python wheel), tests (maintained separately in nccl-tests), and documentation. Key directories include src/ (core implementation), makefiles/ (build configuration), etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on CUDA toolkit, supports multiple GPU architectures (configurable via NVCC_GENCODE). Build system is Makefile-based, producing various package formats.
en.hot: NCCL is NVIDIA's official high-performance GPU communication library, a critical component for distributed deep learning training, relied upon by major frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow. Although today's star increase is modest, it maintains high long-term attention, ranking 4th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Deep learning engineers: training large models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups requiring efficient collective communication.
HPC developers: building high-performance computing applications leveraging GPU clusters.
Framework developers: integrating NCCL to optimize distributed training performance.
Researchers: needing to understand or customize GPU communication primitives for experiments.

zh.tag: Windows 开源防火墙，简单而强大
zh.what: Fort 是一款专为 Windows 7 及以上版本设计的有效防火墙，兼具简单性和健壮性。它提供灵活的网络规则、速度限制、流量统计等功能，并拥有独立驱动。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Fort Firewall 的完整源代码，包括 UI 图标、文档（Wiki）和安装程序构建配置。

zh.tag: 开源免费AI网关，单端点聚合264家模型提供商并智能压缩省token

zh.hot: 本周新增 3,605 Star、总星数突破 1.8 万并登上 GitHub 周榜第 16 名，反映出开发者对「零成本调用多模型」的强烈需求——聚合 90+ 免费提供商与高达 95% 的 token 压缩能力，直接切中了 AI 应用落地时的成本焦虑。

网关/中间件自建者 —— 需要统一端点管理多模型路由、自动容灾和 token 压缩的企业内部 AI 基础设施。

en.tag: Open-source AI gateway aggregating 264 providers with token compression and auto-fallback
en.what: OmniRoute is an open-source free AI gateway that aggregates 264+ providers—including 90+ free tiers—behind a single API endpoint, letting you plug Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and other tools into free Claude, GPT or Gemini instances. It features RTK+Caveman stacked compression to cut token usage by 15–95%, alongside smart auto-fallback, MCP/A2A support, and multimodal APIs.
en.content: The repo ships with a deployable gateway core, a web admin dashboard, PWA and desktop apps, plus routing strategy configs, free-tier documentation, and provider integration templates.

en.hot: It gained 3,605 stars this week, reaching 18.4k total and hitting #16 on GitHub Trending, as developers rush to cut AI costs—aggregating 90+ free providers and slashing token usage by up to 95% directly addresses the biggest barrier to shipping AI apps.
uses: Indie devs & small teams —— Access Claude/GPT/Gemini at zero cost by pooling 90+ free tiers instead of paid APIs.
Power users of AI coding tools —— Redirect Cursor, Cline, Claude Code and Copilot to free model backends via one endpoint.
Platform builders —— Those needing a unified gateway with auto-fallback, routing strategies, and token compression for internal AI infra.

en.what: This is a skill router package for AI coding clients (like Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) that, upon encountering APKs, binaries, frontend JS encryption, CTF challenges, or pentesting targets, routes to the right methodology, checks available tools, and executes repeatable workflows instead of guessing commands. AI tool developers: Reference its architecture to build skill routers for other domains.

AI agent users — engineers using Claude Code, Codex, etc., needing structured skill sets
Tech teams — to standardize AI workflows and improve code quality and maintainability

zh.tag: 港大出品的 AI 私人家教：个性化终身学习工作区

zh.hot: 它把 AI 教育与 Agent 原生工作流结合，并由高校实验室持续维护，概念清晰、可体验性强。
uses: 学生 / 自学者 —— 把教材和论文喂进去，得到 24 小时私人家教
考研 / 考证党 —— 用刷题测验 + 掌握度路径系统备考
知识管理玩家 —— 直接挂 Obsidian 库做 RAG 问答

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace

en.hot: It combines AI education with an agent-native workflow and carries the credibility of a university research lab, making the concept easy to evaluate and share.

PKM enthusiasts — plug your Obsidian vault straight in for RAG Q&A

AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。

AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

en.tag: Low-latency modular voice-agent pipeline with fully local VAD-STT-LLM-TTS stack
en.what: An open-source voice-agent framework from Hugging Face that chains VAD → STT → LLM → TTS into a low-latency, fully modular pipeline for local or hybrid deployments.
